tei:div.tei:p: dbe kun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

dbe kun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang /bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub gos thog ma yin zhing /mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang /glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing /sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang /gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang /mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i blo dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ka'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du brtan mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes wa 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu che dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin—legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//chubatso bod rig po dadku khanagaspyi lo 009lo'i sgron par/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang /bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub gos thog ma yin zhing /mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang /glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing /sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang /gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang /mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i blo dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ka'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes ga wa'agog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen shu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin—legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//chubatso bod rig bdadku khanagaspyi lo 009lo'i sgron par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyisanganas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba brten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nor te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sdodang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du masang tsho'i las dar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga tshog nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshor bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/3

bas sgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung /rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tsho gos pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang /ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang /gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang /sdo srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 17nas 98bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

mdzad ba po'i rnamathar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyalapo'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me rtag cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams gleg bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchoge spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sgrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'byungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyasasogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'brol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsnyen nas gzhud chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsisadang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nasadagung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis lasaslob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang /dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang /de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang /lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang /mdzod la chos mja rin wo 'dren pa'i shing rta/'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang /rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung /de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chagazhal gdams/snyan mgur/snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/lam yigabasko 'ja'/grwa sgo 'don cha/dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o//se/ga tshoganang gas dbe rnying 'tshos bas phyogs ga khang nas/

dkar chagazab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i cho me kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyi ba'i pa/ (1)dus 'khor shong 'gyur steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa'i skor/ 47)klu dang sa bdag gi gdon 'joms pa mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i skor/ (10)spyi bka' brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang ji ltar nos pa'i skor/ (14)sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i rjes gnang gi rim pa ji ltar nod pa sogs kyi skor/ (39)jo bo a ti sha sogs nas nye bar brgyud pa'i snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang ji ltar nos pa'i skor/ (46)'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung 'bum gyi lung ji ltar nos pa'i skor/ 594)rgyal sras thogs med kyi bka' 'bum sogs gsan pa'i lung brgyud/ (110)rgyal ba g.ya' bzang par drang srong gzas dngos su phul ba'i gza' nyi ma mdung gang ma'i skor/ (142)snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bka' 'bum glegs bam gyi rim pa nos pa'i skor/ (151)thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum gyi skor/ (163)thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung brgyud sogs/ (181)rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gis dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas btsal ba'i 'khrid brgya'i skor/ (196)1

ra༅༅/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa bzhus/sa theg/ /༄༅/ /gsum pa gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra bdus kyi 'khor lo'i skor la/ rdzogos pa'i sangarsārgyas shākya seng ge shing pho rta'i lo sa gas nya ba'i tshe zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i mchog mngon du mdzad nas lo bzhi bcu zhe drug 'das pa lcags 'brug nag pa'i zla bar shrī ṅgā n+ya ka ṭa ga'i mchod rten gyi nang gi steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor spros te sprul pa'i chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad/ de'i phyi lo chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus/ byang phyogs sham bha lar chos rgyal drug dang rigs ldan bcu bdun 'das shing rigasaldan seng ge chos kyi khrir 'khod pa'i lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor drug dang nyag ma nyer bdun du slebs pa bong bu zhes pa lcags mo yos kyi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bzhi gza' nyi ma/ skar ma me bzhi/ 'phrod yid/ stor ba grub pa/ byed (2na ngo tshong pa rnams 'dzom pa'i dus chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras skrungs kyi dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang du rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rigs 'dzin chen po chos dbyings rang grol dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ dkyil chog yon to kun 'byung / mchod phreng mchod —1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho rigasung 'bum/ ()sprin rgya mtsho/mkhyen rab rjes mdzad pa'i zin bris bkra shis rab rgyas gzhan yang slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa'i zin bris thor bu bzhugs pa rnams dang /de dag gi go rim khrigs chags su khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod 2bar mas mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i bklagasapas don grub rnams kyi steng nas rdo rje'i slob ma ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi dbang bskur ba la brten nas 'og min srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi bden pa nyid kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ba dang /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gong ma bzhi gong chen dang bcas pa brgyud pa'i bka' babs bzhi dang ldan pa legs par nos pa'i dang po 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/dang po'i sangs rgyas/chos sku rdo rje 'chang /longs sku dus kyi 'khor lo/sprul sku shākya thub pa/tsogs kha lha slo0kyi rjesasu dpal skyong bri pa la thar chags su mi 'dug cing ngor wo gyi gsan mig na chos rgyal sum na rtsa lnga zhes pa la sgo sor ma phral wo kha grangs kyang ca zad ma 'grig pa dpyad/chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/lha'i dbang po/gzi brjid can/zla bas byin/lha'i dbang phyug/sna tshogs gzugs/lha'i dbang ldan te chos rgyal bdun/rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/padma dkar po/bzang po/rnam rgyal/bshes gnyen bzang po/phyag na rin cen/ga dmar ba yang zer/khyab 'jug sbas pa/nyi ma grags pa/shin tu bzang po/rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/'di na tshe mtsho rme dbu mas/rgyal dga'/nyi ma/sna tshogs gzugs/zla ba'i 'od/mtha' yas/sa skyong /dpal skyong /lugs gcig la rig sa nyi ma la slob dpon tsi lu paṇḍita sag/de ṣka dang du ga pa che ba gcig par bzhed cing spyan ra ldan ) gzigs kyi sprul pa'i dge slong zhig la gsan pa sog lo rgyu mi mthun pa mang yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen bu'i gag yig sgo gan bra pa yin/grub chen dus 'khor zhabs pa che chung /che ba tsor ya sha'i pho tso dang wo ba nā tī pa/rgyal sras nā landa pa/bu ston/rje gzha sto kha pa gong dkar thar rtsa los snga sa kho pa rnam kyi gas yig na mi 'dug cing mag rṣa ngag chos pa'i gag yi/ na kha che zla mgon dang rsāg par mdzad/ngor rsā/rdo rje lang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (khanasngags ram pa/ rje mkhyen brtse gsum gi gsan yig na dkyus ltar byung ba dpyad do/ /kha che zla ba mgon po/ paṇa dkar/ 'bro mtho tsā ba shes rab grags/ rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa yig skyon byung ba 'dra/ grab sgom/ 'phan yul ba bod btsun/ dkon cog srung / rnal 'byor bzang po sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ sngags dkar co breg ༅/grub chen yu mo dad pa rgyal po/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug /sngags dkar co breg can/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ sprul sku jo 'bum/ bu ston rje btsong kha pa ngor wo gong dkar thar rtse ngag chos lo pa rnams kyi gsan yig na mi snang bas dpyad/ se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal gsang mas mi bskyod rdo rje/ gas rgan/ mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ phyam rtseb/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ so ston kun rig gi skye bar grags/ bod bas yin/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ jo nang kun mkhyen dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog bzang po/ rje btsun nam mkha' chos skyong / rdo rje rigs bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin tu stsal to/ /bu lugs kyi 'bro'i brgyud pa ni/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes yan gong ltar la/ de nas kunamakhyen 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shar pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ chos rje dkon cog dpal bzang / byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ byang glingarje man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen chos 'od nas/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho man 'dra/ thar lo —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shelo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad (11na)pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas gsum pa char dbab gcod byed pa khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'amang / dus kyi 'bor lo/ shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal rigs ldan so lnga/ dusazhabs pa che chung / kha che zla mgon/ 'bro lo tsā ba/ lha rje sgom pa pa/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras chos kyi dbang phyugs/ se chen nam mkha' 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'jam gsar ba/ bla ma chos 'od/ zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ye/ mkhas bas yon tan rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen dol pa ba/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub nya dbon/ grub chen kun blo/ mkhan 'a dkon cog bzang po/ zha lu lo rsā chos skyong bzang po/ lo wo ratna bha dra/ lo ོ 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa sgru ti pa/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /spyi bka' brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang ji ltar nos pa'i skor/gnyis pa spyi bka' la/ gnas lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇḍita mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug a bha yā ka ra gupta zhes 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas par grags pa ind+ra 5kyi li'i gtsug lag khang du thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bstan pa spel ba'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bud med ba glang sha ba'i rigs su sprul nas sha chang byin pa phyir slog pa'i rten 'brel gyis sku tshe de la mchog gi dngos grub ma thob kyang 'gyod bshags kyis gsol ba btab (11ba)pa'i tshe sgrib sbyong du sngags kyi man ngag du ma dang khyad par sa5 zhi'i 'grel pa rgyas pa gcig /gdul bya rnams kyi 'jug sgo rgyud sde bzhi'i cho ga rgyas pa dang de'i lha'i tshogs rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga lo rgyus gi li la mahā bo dhi lung bas yang — 14

dang gzhan rnams su mngal skyes dang sgong skyes sbyong byed kyi rgyas bsdus kyang mi 'dra/ 'dir bla ma brgyud pa'ang rnal 'byor ma dang a bha ya'i bar du gzhan brgyud mi dgos shing gzhan rnams la so so'i brgyud tshul 'dod dgos pas lha'i mtshan tsam gcig pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas phan tshun gcig go gcig gis gcod pa ni rgyud sde'i phyogs la rnam par mi mkhas pa'i rang mtshang dang / la la mkho che ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas dgra nag gi tshab la 'jigs byed bskur ba sogs 'phreng ba mkhan po'i gsung rab las ring du gyur pa'o/ /sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen yan la rdo rje 'phreng ba las ma dar na'ang paṇḍi ta da rlan ā tsarla zhes 'gro ba'i me long du grags pa des la lī ta badzra sogs mkhas grub mang po la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ mchog gi dngosagrub brnyes/ tshems lan nyi shu brjes shing dgung lo stong dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa des 'phreng bskor gsum du gsal ba de don sor bzhag thog bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi tshad/ mtshan dpe'i ngos 'dzin sogs lhag kha yar dang bcas pa bsnan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i cho ga kṛ ya sa mu tstsha zhes sgrub dkyil yan lag dang bcas pa don tshan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgo nas ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po zhig mdzad pa 'phags pa'i yul (13ba)du dar rgyas shin tu che zhing / bod 'dir thog mar rgya dpe zhig bal po'i tshong pa'i lag nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gcen 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu byung / de la brten nas kun spangs chosagrags dpal bzang gis bdag rkyen mdzad nas bi ka mā la shī la'i paṇḍita chen po mañdzu shrī dang sa bzang lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur kyang chos kyi rgyun med pa la/ mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis bal yul ye rang du kṛ ya sa mutsā'i dbang zhus pa'i gtam thos pa'i rkyen gyis sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros kyis paṇḍita ma hā bo dhi la dbang lung rdzogs par gsan/ de nas 'phreng ba dang kṛ — 17—

so'i brgyud tshul 'dod dgos pas lha'i mtshan tsam gcig pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas phan tshun gcig go gcig gis gcod pa ni rgyud sde'i phyogs la rnam par mi mkhas pa'i rang mtshang dang / la la mkho che ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas dgra nag gi tshab la 'jigs byed bskur ba sogs 'phreng ba mkhan po'i gsung rab las ring du gyur pa'o/ /sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen yan la rdo rje 'phreng ba las ma dar na'ang paṇḍi ta da rlan ā tsarla zhes 'gro ba'i me long du grags pa des la lī ta badzra sogs mkhas grub mang po la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ mchog gi dngosagrub brnyes/ tshems lan nyi shu brjes shing dgung lo stong dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa des phreng bskor gsum du gsal ba de don sor bzhag thog bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi tshad/ mtshan dpe'i ngos 'dzin sogs lhag kha yar dang bcas pa bsnan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i cho ga kṛ ya sa mu tstsha zhes sgrub dkyil yan lag dang bcas pa don tshan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgo nas ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po zhig mdzad pa 'phags pa'i yul (13ba)du dar rgyas shin tu che zhing / bod 'dir thog mar rgya dpe zhig bal po'i tshong pa'i lag nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gcen 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu byung / de la brten nas kun spangs chosagrags dpal bzang gis bdag rkyen mdzad nas bi ka mā la shī la'i paṇḍita chen po mañdzu shrī dang sa bzang lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur kyang chos kyi rgyun med pa la/ mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis bal yul ye rang du kṛ ya sa la dbang zhus pa'i gtam thos pa'i rkyen gyis sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros kyis paṇḍita ma hā bo dhi la dbang lung rdzogs par gsan/ de nas 'phreng ba dang kṛ — 17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neya gnyis dbang gi chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du thar rtse nam mkha' 'khor mang mar 'phreng ba'i steng du kṛ ya'i sgos chos kha yar bsnan pa'i phyag len rgyas pa/ dus 'khor lha grangs mangs pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod yun ring bar brten 'phreng rkyang gi phyag len bsdus shos 'khor lo sgyur drug la kṛ ya'i sgos chos phra mo rnams kyang bsnan pa'i phyag len shin tu rgyas pa thob par/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i mi bskyod pa'i rigs gsang 'dus bcu bdun/ gsung rdo rje zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa lha bcu bdun/ sku rdo — 18

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha bcu bdun rnams gnyis med kyi rgyud/ rgyu ṭi nas gsungs pa'i bde mchog rdo rje sems dpa' (14bsnyo so bdun/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shes du gad chi deb gsheg pa'i rigs su ngos 'dzin par snang ngo / /'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud la brten pa'i rdo rje'i rigs gsang ba'i bdag po 'byung po 'dul byed lha sogasum pa spyod rgyud/ rje gzha stong kha pa'i gsan mig na bya rgyud gsum/ bo ga gsum zhes 'dug pas bya rgyud du bzhed pa 'dra'o/ /de bzhin tshogs pa'i rigs kyi yum 'od zer can ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gzungs gra lnga lha bcu gsum/ 'di yan gyis 'phreng rkyang gi dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis tshang / kṛ ya nas gsungs pa'i bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum zhes pa nor rgyun ma'i rtog chung la brten pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gnas gtsang ma'i lha nor rgyun la lha bcu dgu gza' yum gyi rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rigs byed ma nub byang gi grar bzhugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byas pa'i gza' yum lha zhe drug gam lnga bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma lha sum cu rtsa gsum ste bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang bcas (15brdza mkhas pa rṣa po shākya dpal bzang po/a wa na gi ka bhū mi shrīḥ dbon wo sa gdapal/ ta su pu tra bi mā la shrī bha draḥ de'i sras dri med dpal bzang / mang mkhar lo ka tsakṣu bo dhi sidhaḥ mang mkhar gyi gas yig na bikṣa ra mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gsan yig na bikṣa ra de wa dang thar rtsesangs rgyas seng ger gsan pa dang shar ba'i gsan yig na rnam grag lha ra ba 'dug cing sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na bi khya de wa ste rnam bshad lha zhes snang ba sogs mi mthun tsam kha yar byung ba slar yang brtag go/sa bzang ma hā paṇḍi ta ma ti ṅgā dza/ sa bzang paṇa 'a blo gros sto mas/ sa bzang ārla ku mā ra ma ti sa bzang 'phags pa gas nu blo gros/badzra dhar a nanda bha dra: rdo rje lang kun dga' bzang po/ bo dhi sa twa ma ti ratna byang tso sems dpa' blo gros rin cen/mañdzu sto ṣa bzhi ratnaḥ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/ dzi na pa ra —20

na shrī bha dra thar rtse ge mkhas gru༅mo skad pal bzang /16na〉 mi paṇḍa ka mañdzu sto ṣa ā nanda pu sto ni rā bho ga me ga la kirti dhwa dzaḥ skya pa 'jam dbyangs dga' bar nams sa grub ba po shi grags po rgyal mtshan/ma hā paṇḍita wā gis dharmā kirtiḥmakhas pa shong gdabang chos grags/pra bhu badzra sa tā nā tha pu rnyotta ma balha san phya dhwa dza shrī bha dra khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mas dpal bzang po/te nā sma khru ho ra go mi ku ṭi po ṭa la su swā bha wa dwa rla lo ke shwa ra su gas le3l da des bdag rngo sto bzhel pho brang po ta la'i rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag khang du stsal to//bā ratna ni rā stogataḥyang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/gu bo kṛ ha pradzñā bhā dzaḥshar khang pa shes rab sto mas/mo snya gra pa ni : sa mā na thar rtse pa man 'dra/tsa pa ra ma de wa sgyu tra/yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/pu bo kṛ ha ni : sa mā naḥshar khang pa man 'dra/bā ratna ni rā bho gā taḥyang na dkon cog lhun la nas/47san ma tso' grags/rje bar nams ye shes/༷ston bar nam grags pa man tsā/'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel la nos kyang brgyud pa ma byung ngo //yang na zhi ba 'tsho nas/bo dhi satwa wo ba/rgyal rgyal mtshan/43ba7 pa dbang mdzes/gya pa dpal mdzes/yon to dbang phyug shangs 9pa 'dul 'dzin/'di'i gong du bla ma jo 〉zer ba smo paṇa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/phu chung ba gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/rnal 'byor ka ma ba 'brom rin cen rgyal mtshan/shad ston dar ma rgyal mtshan/stabs ka pa 'brom byang chub bzang po/ston pa nam mkha'i rin cen/'brom gzhen nu blo gros/45na khor thang mkhan po nyi ma rgyal mtshan/gling kha ba rin cen byang chub/thar rtse pa'i gas yig na lha lung zhes snang /sga lung pa rigs kyi bdag po'i dpal/sga lung pa byang lho dpal/yi pa'i slob dpon bsod nams 'od zer/gos sngon chu ser ba sangs rgyas bzang po/bya bral ba bsod nams bzang po/thar rtse phogs thor 'di gnyis go ldog tu gshig ga/bla ma dpal ldan pa/stag tshang chos 'khor ba mkhan chen nam mkha' 'od zer/pa tshab dga' gdong pa gnas brtan ye shes tshul khrims/nub chos lung pa mkhan chen ratna ā ka ra shānti/gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/rje nam mkha' dbang phyug/chos rje kun dga' legs grub/lum pa kun dga' chos gsan yig phal cher na mi 'dug pas ma thob/ dpal kye rdo rje brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi rgyud kyi lon)rgyal po'i bsdus don mjug tu/ bdag gis mi shes blo dman phyir/ rgyud don ji bzhin ma rtogs pas zhes sogs rdzogs byang dang bcas pa/ 'di'i 'og tu gas yig phal〉 na mnga' ris pasamadzad pa'i brtag gnyes kyi tshig 'grel yod tshul 'dug kyang gsan yig rgya mtshor ma byung bas lung ma thob/ med gsung ba byung na'ang tsho chen gyi gsung ngo ma yin pas bod pa legs/ 'gor blo gros mtshungs med 'jig rten kun gyi mig ces yod pa'i brtag gnyis —66

rgya po dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('a.a la la ho sa mā ya ri zhes yod pa'i phur pa'i las byang bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor 'jam dpal khri drug stong yod pa'i le'u drug pa 'jam dpal glu blangs kyi le'u zhes yod pa'i 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭīkka rtog ni/gsad pa'i las kyi chos su sbyar ba yin gyi mtha' can/ 'gor dang po mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma la zhes yod pa'i sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog dbang gi cho ga tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas bstan (zhang)pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ man ngag gces bsdus la bir wa pa'i chu bsrung nas bzung mdzes ma rgyan 'khor gyi bar man ngag gi rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug lhag tsam phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ 'di gsan yig rgya mtshor lha mo'i 'od ljang ma yan la mi 'dug cing gong ma lnga'i gsung 'bum gyi mjug tu bris kyang rtsa ba'i bla mas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar gsan cing / grub pa'i slob dpon du ma'i man ngag dang rje btsun chen po'i phyag len gces bsdus dang sa paṇa gyi lam sbas bshad sogs nas kyang blangs pa'i slob brgyud cig gis phyis su bsgrigs pa'i lung rgyun mkhan chen sher rdor bas gsan pa 'dir bcug par mngon 'di nang gi chosatshan mang po'i brgyud pa lam 'bras kyi cha lag glegs bam rnams dang yang gcig go/ 'phags pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las byung ba'i uṣṭi dzi'i bsrung 'khor bla ma'i man ngag gis bsdebs pa yin no'i mtha' can/ ma hā ma ya'i rgyud stong phrag bco (51nasgo rgyad pa las phyung ba bha ya na'i man ngag byin rlabs shin tu che ba yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ skyu ra a skyabs la phul ba'i zhu yig bla ma rnams kyi bran du skye bar smon pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang ngam khang bzang zhes yod pa'i 'bum gter gzhug tshul tshul bzhin shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ dur khrod bdag po'i skor (khum)la rjes gnang gi tho bla ma'i gsung bzhin dpal yu kha mo sgrol ma lha khang du bsgrigs pa/dkar chag dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na migs la/ bdag g.yin bsrung ba bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa phyag rgya chen po thob par shog gi mtha' can/ sku rten sba wa man ngag go'i mtha' can/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i ṭīkka mu tig 'phreng ba rnams/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs dang ngor lugs kyi gsan yig rnams nas gnyal phu chung pas mdzad par ngos bzung / rje mus sad pas—70

rgya po dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('a.a la la ho sa mā ya ri zhes yod pa'i phur pa'i las byang bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor 'jam dpal khri drug stong yod pa'i le'u drug pa 'jam dpal glu blangs kyi le'u zhes yod pa'i 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭīkka rtog ni/gsad pa'i las kyi chos su sbyar ba yin gyi mtha' can/ 'gor dang po mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma la zhes yod pa'i sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog dbang gi cho ga tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas bstan (zhang)pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ man ngag gces bsdus la bir wa pa'i chu bsrung nas bzung mdzes ma rgyan 'khor gyi bar man ngag gi rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug lhag tsam phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ 'di gsan yig rgya mtshor lha mo'i 'od ljang ma yan la mi 'dug cing gong ma lnga'i gsung 'bum gyi mjug tu bris kyang rtsa ba'i bla mas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar gsan cing / grub pa'i slob dpon du ma'i man ngag dang rje btsun chen po'i phyag len gces bsdus dang sa paṇa gyi lam sbas bshad sogs nas kyang blangs pa'i slob brgyud cig gis phyis su bsgrigs pa'i lung rgyun mkhan chen sher rdor bas gsan pa 'dir bcug par mngon 'di nang gi chosatshan mang po'i brgyud pa lam 'bras kyi cha lag glegs bam rnams dang yang gcig go/ 'phags pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las byung ba'i uṣṭi dzi'i bsrung 'khor bla ma'i man ngag gis bsdebs pa yin no'i mtha' can/ ma hā ma ya'i rgyud stong phrag bco (51nasgo rgyad pa las phyung ba bha ya na'i man ngag byin rlabs shin tu che ba yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ skyu ra a skyabs la phul ba'i zhu yig bla ma rnams kyi bran du skye bar smon pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang ngam khang bzang zhes yod pa'i 'bum gter gzhug tshul tshul bzhin shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ dur khrod bdag po'i skor (khum)la rjes gnang gi tho bla ma'i gsung bzhin dpal yu kha mo sgrol ma lha khang du bsgrigs pa/dkar chag dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na migs la/ bdag gzhan bsrung ba bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa phyag rgya chen po thob par shog gi mtha' can/ sku rten sba wa man ngag ge'i mtha' can/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i ṭīkka mu tig 'phreng ba rnams/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs dang ngor lugs kyi gsan yig rnams nas gnyal phu chung pas mdzad par ngos bzung / rje mus sad pas—70

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negasung rab la/ gsung (nyi)ngag rin po che'i brgyud 'debs bla ma rdor 'dzin ma/ stag sde ri (dbang/sbug gi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub shes rab kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i sa chen gyi rnam thar/ slob dpon rin po che'i rnam ltar)thar (53ba)gsol 'debs dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs ma mjug tu tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin pa sogs yod pa/ dbang la phyug 'od zer gyi ngor rtsang kha dgon du mdzad pa'i mtshar gsum khug pa'i man ngag /stong 6) thun sa bcad chos mtha' dag gi bsdus pa'i don ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gas yig ga' na tshor 'di'i 'og tu rgyud sde'i dum bu zhes pa zhig 'dug kyang dkar chag gong dkar ba mkhyen brtse gsum gyi gsan yig na mi snang wo lung yang bang /rgyud gsum gyi mngon (ka)par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing / rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i rnam bshad ma dag pa rnams rnam par 'jom par byed pa'i rnam par 'grel pa (ka)dag ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi sa bcad (ka)min dha ra thā rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rgyang ro'i 'bun ju jo sras dge slong shes rab rin cen gyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i 'phags pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyan (ka)zhes bya ba'i rnam par 'grel pa/ 'di'i 'og tu gur gyi thig 'a gyi chog smo 2ga pa thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na go pa'i gas lhag gi la brten lung ma byung /mngon (nyi)rtogs yan (a)lag drug pa/ ngor phyogs la gcig las mi 'dug kyang gong dkar lugs la gnyis su 'dug pa'i tshig sna thung ba de thob pa yin pas dpe bsdur dgos yod/ sku rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dha byang chub sems dpa'i lugs ba ri ba nas brgyud pa/ kye rdo rje'i bstod (mig)pa sdeb sbyor dhaṇḍa ka /dkyil 'khor gyi (sdu shegatso bo dang cas pa'i bdag med lha mo bco lnga la bstod pa rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i 'phreng ba dri ma med pa/ rdo rje 9)bdag med (a)ma'i mngon rtogs(54na'am pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa/ bdag med 9da(6)ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa mnyam par bskur ba'i lag len gyi tho yig /'di pod khrar tsho dang la'o//su'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis yan gong ltar la/de nas bde ba can pa mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po/rnam mkhyen grong pa sprul pa rnam dpyod shis tu gtsang ba'i dpyad bzod pa nas bkod par/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne'agro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung 'bum gyi lung ji ltar nos pa'i skor/lnga pa srid zhi'i gtsug tor mdzes rgyan chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab la lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod (nyi)sangs rgyas sku dngos ma/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ku mi dhi'i bshad pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs me tog 'phreng ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang gi byang chub ma/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dpal ldan sangs rgyas rgyas ma/ kye rdor bka' babs bzhi nas mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yan gyi bla ma'i mtshan 'bum legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur ba/ sa paṇa gyi bstod pa dpal mchog ma/ de'i bstod pa srid gsum ma/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa mu tig 'phreng ba/ sa paṇa gyi bstod pa blo chen ma/ de'i bstod pa gang gi sngon du ma/ de nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa yan lag bdun ldan re bo rtse lngar mdzad pa/ dkon cog gsum la bstod pa bsod nams chu gter ma/ sa paṇa la mtshan spel gyi bstod pa 'gro kun ma dang kun dga' rin cen ma ste blo ka re re/ de'i bstod pa kun mkhyen ma zhes pa'i tshig ring gcig /kun chos zhes pa'i blo ka gcig /bde legs ma zhes pa'i blo ka gcig /gang thugs ma zhes pa'i tshig sna ring ba gcig /bsod nams ma zhes pa'i shlau ka gsum pa gcig /ting 'dzin ma zhes pa'i shlau ka gcig /mkhyen pa'i snying po zhes pa'i glo ka gsum pa gcig ste bstod chung bdun/ gzha yig cha bstod chung bdun las ming gsal med cing mdzad byang mi gsal yang 'di bzhi yin nam snyam/ thogs med sku mched 48na)phyogs glang chos grags sogs la bstod pa rnam grol lo tog rnam par skyed mdzad bla ma rgyal gyi mtha' can/thos pa rgya mtsho/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bstod pa gzhung lugs chu bo brgya 'gyed/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs par rab tu byed pa'i rnam bshad/ bla ma dam pa la maṇḍal —94

dag sgrub pa/ yang de'i don du mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las gsungs pa'i yan lag bdun pa/ la shing mkhan po shes rab grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i zhal gdams tshul dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)dkar 'gyed/ dmar 'gyed/ phung po zan skyur/ mi rkang 'bud pa'i 'byul 'khor (86gong na snamasakyi dmigs rim/ yang 'jam dbyangs mgon po'i phyag bzhes gtso bor bton pa'i mgo 'khor tshar tshad mi 'byung ba zil gnon/ dbyings rig bsre ba dkar 'gyed/ dmar 'gyed/ keng rus me 'bar gyi dmigs rim rnams legs par thob nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ gcod thams cad kyi go ba bskyed pa spyi 'khrid kyi skor/ lag len nyams khrid kyi skor/ zhal gdams gegs sel bogs 'don gyi skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ dkar chag gsal ba'i me long / brgyud pa'i lo rgyus jo mo'i rnam thar dang bcas pa/ pradzñā su bhā was mdzad pa/ bka' tshoms chen mo zhu lan sum cu rtsa lnga pa gegs sel nyer gcig yang / tsho mes nyer lnga dang bcas pa/ a ma'i zhal gdams le lag drug skor/ pradzñā su bhā wasamadzad pa'i zab don thugs kyi snying po'i spyi khrid kyi gzhung / de'i bsdus don 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad/ de'i 'grel pa bka' shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i dgongs pa grub thob rnams kyi zhal gdams bdud kyi gcod yul 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba'i chos 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad pa rnams/ gnyis pa nyams khrid kyi skor la/ zhag bdun ma zhes rgyas pa dang bsdus pa stan thog gcig ma gnyis so/ /gsum pa gegs sel bogs 'don gyi skor la sgo 'byed dang thor bu gnyis las/ dang po la/dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed/ ngo sprod nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed/ rmi lam nyi zla sgo 'byed/ 'go ba thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ bar do 'od gsal sgo 'byed/ gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed/ bogs 'don yon to sgo 'byed/ gzhan don 'phrin las sgo (86gong bgyi byed/grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed/ de bcu po 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad pa/ gnyis pa thor bu'i skor la/ sgrub thabs kyi lhan thabs/ dur khrod rgyan gyi gsang sgrub/ sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhal gdams/ gtor 'bul dang sde brgyad 'bum bskul dmigs 'bum chen mo/ nag sbyor bco lnga rnamasanos pa'i g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa la lugs bzhir yod pa'i pho brgyud ni/ thabs bas — 121 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('akyang zer/ bya rgod phung por ston pa sangs rgyas/ ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dbyangs smra seng/ rgya gar 'jag spyil du ārla de wa/ sras brgyud ni/ thar rtsedang lo pa'i gas yig tu pho brgyud chung bzer/ dar ldings pa'i ga yigatubade tshogs bakhe brgyud par ngos gas / bya rgod phung por ston pa sangs rgyas/ dga' ldan lha yul du byamasapa mgon po/ ri bo bya rkang du 'phags pa thogs med/ nā lend+ra ru paṇa chen dbyig gnyen/ rgya gar 'jag spyil du ārla de wa/ mo brgyud ni/ shes rab brgyud kyang zer/'og min du yum chen mo/ g.yu lo bkod par rje btsun sgrol ma/ rgya gar dur khrod du su kha sirnyi/ bzhi pa gsum ga 'dus pa don gyi brgyud pa ni/dar sdings pa'i gas yig na nyas len lag sud kyi brgyud pa zer/ding ri glang 'khor du dam pa sangs rgyas/ 'disa'aphags pa lha dang bde ba'i dngos grub gnyis/la gas/ ra sa chu bzang du skyo chen ye shes bla ma/ dar sdings pa'i gsan yig na 'di mi khrug /gangs bar lha khang du skyo chung bsod nams bla ma/ thar rtsedang lo pa'i gas yig tu ra sa da lung zer ba snang / zangs ri khang dmar du ma gcig lab sgron/ e chung glang lung du rgyal ba don grub/ ma' brtse thar rtse yon gsum gyi gsan yig na bla ma 'di gnyis ma byung bas dpyad/ dag pa chos dbyings pho brang du 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ snye mo khu'i ra bar khu (86'og na ma chos seng / khung smad lcang sar dgon par dol pa zang thal/ thar rtse dang lo pa'i gsan yig na lcang 'tshal dbus zang thal zer ba 'dug /rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dol b.rang snang ngo / /g.yor stod chu bo rir rgya nag tsor bu/ bkra shis mthong smon du rgya sgom ri pa/ ra ba grong gser gling du sangs rab ston/ rje ma' brtse'i gas yig na phug rdzorsā sangs rgyas ra sgom zhes pa snang / zal mo brag gi mthar rtsar rtogs ldan dge slong / rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu sangs rgyas dge slong zhes snang / kha rag mun khang du sum ston ras pa/ rje mtshe ge'i gsha yig tu stobadzra tsherang / ri gong dpal gyi gnas su sangasargyas ston pa/ brtson khrus4ge ra/ nyang stod bsam gling du mkhas pa rdo rje/ dar sgo pa'i gas yig na mkhasagrub chos rje zer/ gnas mchog grags chen du rdo rje'i mtshan can/ dar sdings pa'i gas yig na 'di gnyis gong 'og ldog bog /gser gling dgon pa ru bkra shis mtshan can/ dag pa'i gzhal yas su kun dga'i mtshan can/ dpal gyi mthar rtsa ru chos kyi rgya mtsho/ chos sdings ri khrod du rgod phrug ras pa/ o ༅ rtse mor — 122

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nenam mkha' legs grub/ ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin chen po kun dga' tshe mchog /rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings grol/ desabadag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na yang dgon pa nas/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/ rtogs ldan shes rab mgon po/ rin cen gzhen nu man 'dra/ yang na rgod tshang pa nas/ o rgyan pa rin cen dpal (88ba)lha wo pa/ blo bzang pa/ khams ston pa/ sne'u pa/ bla ma rin cen gzhon nu man 'dra/ deng sang phyag chen pa rnams rdo rje 'chang tai lo nā ro zhes 'dren pa ni mi rigs te phyag chen 'di rgya gar nas chig brgyud byung ba'i dbang du song na rje mar pas lta ba'i phu thag gcod sa mi tri pa yin pas spyan snga lha gzigasaras pa'i brgyud lugs 'di nyid dpyad bzod par mngon/ spyir phyag rgya chen po zhes pa dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi lam yin la/ gnas lugs kyi lta ba la phyag chen du ming btags pa 'di 'dra rje mi la yan med pa'i rgyu mtshan sgam po dang mi la mjal ba'i dus sgam po pas bka' gdams kyi chos la thos bsam mdzad tshul sogs zhus pas de 'dras gar yang mi phyin/ kho bo'i gtu pa mo a thung 'di sgoms dang da bzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba yin zhes rgya cher gsungs pa las phyag rgya chen po'i sgros tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ 'di dwags po rin po che'i thugs nyams su shar ba'i grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa yin par sems so/ /yar klungs jo bos mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa nas bar skabs kyi brgyud pa rnams ma rnyed/ rtses dang byang ma khang gsar pa dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'tshang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal o rgyan chen po'i gter lung du 'dan ma rtse mang gi skye bar lung gis zin pa'i tshal pa si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros sam drung chen kun dga' rdo rjer grags pa'i phyag bris ma'i (80na 'gro mgon 'ang g.yu brag pa'i dka' 'bum pod bzhi ma'i steng nas lung nos pa la/ si tu — 126

kyi cho ga rnams/bzhi pa theg pa che chung gi grub mtha'i skor la/chos spyi'i stong thun gleng gzhi chen mo khams ston blo gros kyi ngor bkod pa/dkar mkha rtsalas lta isngosnang yang bsdus pa ma rnyed/grub mtha' chigs gsum 'phrul gyi lde mig gcig shes kun la mkhas pa gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed/'jag sgom byang chub snying po'i don du mdzad pa'i tshom gyi rim pa/bden gnyis zung 'brel le'u bco lnga pa/de'i sa bcad/grub mtha'i rang blo'i skyon sel/de'i sabacad/rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa bla ma bsam grub kyi don du mdzad pa/de'i sa bcad/rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa nyi ma snang ba le'u bcu pa 'bras bu 'char tshul dang bcas pa/lam mchog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/phan byed rab gsal nor bu'i phreng ba/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongasapa'i nying phug chen mo zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa phan bde nyi ma'i snying po le'u bcu bzhi pa/khams ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i zung 'jug gi don phyin ci ma log pa dam pa'i don gyi mthar thug/rje rgyal btsas po phreng gol la po/la gdams pa kun tshang thugs kyi gnyen po/byang chub sems kyi tshigs su bcad pa bco brgyad pa/zung gsum ya drug gi zhal gdams/dgongs pa bkang ba'i gleng 91na tha slang /le'u lnga pa/chos brgyad spang ba'i yig chung /'dul ba thams cad kyi lde mig so so thar pa'i sdom pa blo gros nges pa rnams/lnga pa nyams len sgom 'khrid kyi skor la/chos dang chos nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'khrid kyi lung sbyar zhes pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag/slob dpon shāka ye sku mched la gsungs pa'i 'khrid yig bshes gnyen dam pa'i ngo la 'khrid lugs shin tu gsal bar bris pa/yang de nyid la gsungs pa'i 'khrid bsdus pa gang la'ang mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro'i mthaX can/ras sgom gyi don du sbyar ba'i 'khrid yig

po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la zhug brgyud pa ma rnyed/ shud bu pa mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nam gsang mtshan las kyi rdo rjer grags pa la dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sogs yi dam gyi lhas byin gyis brlabs shing gsung gi gnang ba dngos su stsal ba'i bsnyan brgyud kyi chos zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i skor nos pa la/(102ba)byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrid kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas don dam sems bskyed kyi byin rlabs/ don gsal sgron me la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi tshe sgrub nas kha 'geng ba'i phyag len ltar mgon po tshe dpag med lha bcu dgu'i tshe dbang / snur lugs kyi mngon rtogs dang dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi steng nas rdo rje rnam 'joms rtsa ba'i lha so lnga 'khyams kyi pho nya ma drug cu phrag bzhi dang bcas pa'i dbang /dngos grub gter mdzod kyi yi ge'i steng nas phyag rdor zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku lnga'i rjes gnang /phyag rdor zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs gces 'phreng gi yi ge'i steng nas phyag rdor gtum po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thugs skar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du phyag drug pa bkod pa'i rjes gnang / gces 'phreng gi bdag byin rlabs dang bdud rtsi thigs pa'i mngon rtogs kyi yi ge la brten nas/ phyag rdor zhal gsum phyag drug pa bdud rtsi thigs pa'i rjes gnang rnams legs par nos/rgyab rten lung mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i shangs mtshal snag tshar bsres nas dngos kyi slob ma nam mkha' blo gros dang nam mkha' 'od zer gnyis kyis rgyu sbyar gnyos kyi btsun pa rin cen legs grub kyis bris pa'i glegs bam gyi steng nas nos pa la nye gnas nam mkha' lhun rgyal gyi ngor gnang ba'i phyi'i rnam thar lung bstan bdud rtsi'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba sgrub pa'i zhal bkod dang bcas pa/ gsang bdag gyis shud bu'i zhal ngo 'ga' zhig gis sku'i skye ba bstan pa'i lung bstan nyung ngu / nang (103na)gi rnam thar gyi gang zag rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (kedapung rnam 'thag ma/ 'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i nyams len mdor bsdus blo ka bzhi dang rkang pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ bgrod pa tshigs bcad/ rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa mdun legs ma/ lam rim bsdus don/bla na med pa'i rin cen gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya phan bde la spyor ba'i rim pa/ dang po las can bkri ba'i gnad gsal bar ston pa/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po/ rje btsun re mda' ba sa skyar bzhugs skabs rtogs ldan byang seng ba grogs mched btang nas phul ba'i zhu yig /bla ma dbu ma pa la mdo khams su phul ba'i zhu yig /mkhan chen phyag rdor ba la sman mchog bdud rtsi'i 'phrong ba 'byor tshul gyi zhu lan/ lam gyi gnad gsum bstan (109ba)pa/ dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar/ bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba len pa'i smon lam zhing mchog sgo 'byed/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan ngag dpag bsam gyi ljon shing /sa skyong spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po grags pa byang chub kyi rtogs brjod snyan ngag byin rlabs kyi lhun po/tshogs chen po'i mkhan po rgyal dbang la phul ba'i zhu yig /bshes gnyen chen po byang chub bla ma'i 'phrin lan/ sa bzang lo tsā bas mtshan/ 'du pob lon pa/ la 'di phyir phan pa'i thabasal gnang ba/ mkhas pa chen po gsang phu ba gzhen nu blo ldan gyi dris lan/ dka' bzhi 'dzin pa shesarab dpal bzang shang pa kun mkhyen/ gi dris lan/ gnyal ston rin cen bsam grub ga4 phu ba/ kyi drisalan/ dbon po nam mkha' dpal bzang garsāg dag po/ gi 'phrin lan gsum/ dpal 'byor bzang po la gnang ba'i gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes rgya yul du thegs dus gnang ba'i bsre 'pho'i gdams pa/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa'i drin lan/ de la — 156

pa byang chub kyi rtogs brjod snyan ngag byin rlabs kyi lhun po/tshogs chen po'i mkhan po rgyal dbang la phul ba'i zhu yig /bshes gnyen chen po byang chub bla ma'i 'phrin lan/ sa bzang lo tsā bas chos rje shākya ye shes rgya yul du thegs dus gnang ba'i bsre 'pho'i gdams pa/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa'i drin lan/ de la — 156

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)gdams pa'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum/ yang de'i zhu lan/ 'gro mgon rdo rje dpal la gdams pa/gsal byed sum cu la e srog tu zhugs pa'i rgyan gyi zhal gdams/ o srog tu zhugs pa'i zhal gdams/ byang bla ma'i zhu lan/ re mda' pa'i nye gnas yon tan rgyal mtshan (110na)gyi zhu lan/slob dpon blo gros 'phel gyi zhu lan/ dme de bzhin gshegs pa la phul ba'i zhu yig /spyan snga rin cen dpal ba'i phebs lam/ gong ma hor rgyal bu mi'i dbang po'i drung du phul ba'i zhu yig /gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la phul ba'i zhu yig gnyis/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nepa bzhengs pa'i dus gnang ba'i dkar chag smon lam/ gong ma chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyisabaka' gnang ba la brten nas 'ol dga' ba rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis yum bar ma bzhengs pa'i dus gnang ba'i smon lam bde gshegs ma/ rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ chos 'phel las thos/ de nyid kyi gsung 'bum thor bu khri rin po che sangs rgyas rin cen dang / rnam gzhag rim pa chos rje phag spyon la zhus gsung brgyud pa gzhan ma byung / pha rkyang gi rtags yod pa'i mar ston sems dpa' chen po/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun kun dga' bkra shis/ mnga' ris drung pa rin po che lha'i btsun pa/brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /pha dga' 'khyil can gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal nas/ 'phags mchog don grub rin cen/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ gye re lha dbang rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /pha g.yung drung can gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub shes rab seng ge /rje sbyin pa dpal ba/ rje smra ba'i seng ge /mar ston tshul khrimasarin cen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa/ mnga' ris lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / sngags — 158

ba'i seng ge /mar ston tshul khrimasarin cen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa/ mnga' ris lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / sngags — 158

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)ram pa bzang po rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/tshe'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rje blo gros chos skyong / lde ri mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen dpal ldan 'od zer/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa/ mnga' ris lha btsun pa/ e pa lha chos rje nges legs dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang (111ba)pha bong kha pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dar ma rin cen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ zhal snga nas skal bzang rgya mtsho/ 'ol dga' lba ba 'jam dbyangs blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gu'i rtags yod rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhebarten nas dga' bzhi 'dren tshul sogs gnad che ba'i yig chung bsnan pas nyi shu rtsa gcig /yig chung nyer gcig tu mi gtogs pa'i lus dkyil gyi yig chung sogs bskyed rim la nye bar mkho ba rjes 'brel dang bcas pa rnams nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang / rje cho me kyi rgyal mtshan/ mtshudas med grags pa bzang po/ mkhan chen dpal ldan 'od zer/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / slob dpon bkra shis pa/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rje 'dul ba 'dzin pas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum gyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa gong ma rnams gsan yig 'thor pa'i khrod du song bas ma rnyed/ rtses dang byang ma khang gsar pa dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po'i gzhi gsum cho ga'i lung mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la zhus/ des rje sangs rgyas ye shes la gsan/ de yan gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi gsung 'bum thor bu'i skor la/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdus par bsngags pa dad pa'i rol mtsho/ de'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa dpal ldan sa gsum ma/ de nyid (112ba)gang du mngon par rtogs par 'tshang rgya tshul la ston pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i bkod par smon lam du bya ba/ de nyid la bstod pa mi byed ma/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstod tshig tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo/ slob dpon rin po che grags pa'i mtshan can la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs pa tshogs gnyis ma/ mkhan chen tsha kho ba ngag dbang grags pa la bstod pa tshogs gnyis cha shas ma/ snying po don gsum gyi brgyud 'debs tshogs gnyis —160

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha) wa wa cog chos 'phel la zhus/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams ma byung /paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i rdzas kyi gtum mo'i gdams pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇḍita nags kyi rin cen/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ 'bras spungs chos rje legs pa chos 'byor/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ drung pa lha rin ngo che/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ grub chen na kha ba thar pa'i rgyal mtshan/ slob dngo na skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o /thams cad mkhyen pa 'gos lo ye bzang rtse pa gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i deb ther sngon po'i nang nas gsang sngags rnying ma/ bstan pa phyi dar/ spyod yul gsum gyi chos 'byung gi lung ni/'gos lo tsā ba gzhen nu dpal/ rtsis dang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de nas bla ma gnyis tsam zhig ma rnyed/ byang ma khang gsar ba dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bo nga la pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum gyi skor/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum gyi skor la/ kun 'dzin zhes nga sa pho byi lo yan gyi rang nyid kyi rnam par thar pa/ yab chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar nor bu'i them skas/ bla ma'i bstod tshogs la jo bo rje la bstod pa snang ba mtha' yas ma/ 'brom la bstod pa lhar bcas ma/ de la bstod pa rab mas phyogs bcu ma/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong (114ba)kha pa chen por bstod pa byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo/ de nyid la bsngags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs/ mgon ngo klu sgrub la bstod pa mchog tu dang ba'i sgra dbyangs/ dpal ri khrod zhabs la bstod pa ji snyed chos kun ma/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhar bstod pa padma dkar po'i chun po/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang — 163—

pa dngos grub gnyis kyi bang mdzod/ 'bras spungs chos rje 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros la bstod pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ de'i bstod pa mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan/ yab rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal cu pa'i rnam bshad dbu ma'i lam rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa legs bshad snying po'i tshig don bshad pa bla na med pa'i 'jug dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (khanardzogs kyi dpe gzhan ma rnyed par sde pa 'phyos pas bzhengs pa'i gser chos po ti lnga po dga' ldan pho brang nas g.yar ba'i de thog nas lung zhug gsung / thams cad mkhyen pa zhing brje kha'i sku mtshamasakhog nas sprul sku 'phrang kha bar gnang ba'i chab shog sogs la da lta lung mdzad 'dug kyang da musanas ring por ma lon par sku gshegs shing / de khog tu chos rje rje btsun par lung 'ong don mi snang /snyun g.yog sogs der 'khod rnams kyis kyang sku ma bde ba'i dus lung zhu nus rigs su min 'dug pas phra zhing phra ba'i rgyun yod med the tshom gyi gzhir gnang ngo / /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i brgya bzhi'i cho ga'i rlung gi brgyud pa ni/ thams (127na)cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ drung pa lha rin po che bsod nams dpal bzang / zur chen gzhen nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung brgyud sogs/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i skor la/ gu ru drag po'i bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rgyun chags/ des mdzad pa'i bden bzhi'i bstod pa dbyangs can grub pa'i ngag /rdo rje 'jigasabyed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las mtha' srid gsum za ba'i sreg khang 'bar ba rnams mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la zhus/ brgyud pa gsal ba ma byung / dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong ma 'khor bcas la gsol mchod 'bul ba dngos grub char 'bebs kyi lung brgyud ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /brgya bzhi'i cho ga bklags pas don grub/ rang bstod rgya chen bsod nams ma/ chos skyong beg rtse'i bstod pa chos dbyings bde chen ma/ yum gyi bstod pa rig pa'i lha mo ma rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/—181 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhethams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rje pha bong kha pa man gong bzhin no/ grub ston blo gros lo das med/ bla ma tshe dbang pa/ gnas rnying chos rje rgyal mtshan rin cen/ gnang rnying cho me rje kun dga' bde legs/ thams cad mkhyen (127ba)pa dge 'dun rgya rme tsho/ paṇa chen bsod lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong nas rje bla ma'i dbon sras chos kyi rje'i thugs dag snang gi gsung lan du mdzad pa rje yongs grags ma/ rtsa 'khor lo lnga ldan las brtsams pa'i nyams dbyangs gsol 'debs spyi bo bde chen ma/ dpal ldan mgon po'i nyams len bla ma'i gsung dang rang gi nyams myong bzhin skal ldan gsar pa'i don du lhug par bris pa snang stong 'ja' tshon ma rnams/ dad ldan mi'i dbang por gdams pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa/ ma ga dha bzang mo dang tshul mtshungs pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mi'i dbang mo'i gsung gis bskul — 183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhe( me khan)ba'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul/ rig ma bcu drug 'bul ba yan chad grub mtshams su 'phro lus pa bla ma dam pa'i thugs sras rdo rje'i mched po bod mkhar rin po che dang 'dar nas sde pa yab yum gyis bka' gnang ba'i ngor 'phros rnams 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses (mkhan ga)mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i gter mdzod/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa'i bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod/ zab lung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang gi sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma'i drung du au ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas zhal (129na gzigs (gnas)dus bstod pa thugs rje chu gter g.yo ba'i dri bzhen/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud par gsol 'debs ( me khan)rto )pa dngos grub rin cen char 'bebs/ rje btsun 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes la bstod pa snyan brgyud pad mtsho ba 'ad pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan la bstod pa snyan brgyud rin cen bye bas btams pa'i mtsho chen/ bdag chen sngags 'chang chen pos gdong kha pa'i dmag dang lhan cig par sku la bsdo bar nye ba'i tshe rje btsun kun spangs chen po seng ger chibs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas dbugs dbyung bar brten rgol ngan rnams kyis ma mthong bar glags blta bar ma nus pa'i tshe bstod pa bdud dpung phyer 'thag ma/ de nyid la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa mtha' yas ma/ de'i yon tan rtogs pa brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dngos grub yid bzhin gyi chu gter bshad pa/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas la rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun pa mdor bsdus te bstod pa byang phyogs mkhas grub ma/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa lcags thang dka' bzhi pa chen po 'khrul zhig ratna bha dra la bstod pa dkon cog gsum dngos kyis bskul ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu zhabs kyis srol phye ba'i zab lam rim pa lnga'i dmar 'khrid/ dga' ldan bka' brgyud kyi phyag chen rtsa ba rgyal ba'i gzhung lam/phyag chen gyi bshad pa yang gsal sgron me rnams rje nyid las dngos su thob/ de'ang khri rin po che dkon cog chos 'phel dang sras khang sku skye ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs dus de'i mkhas grub rnams kyis rje btsun btsong kha pa chen pos byang rtser gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs la lta ba phyag rgya pa'i lugs dang mthun par gsungs shing / de la brten nas mtshungs med chos rje'i dbu ma'i ṭī skar rang lugs dbu ma'i lta ba bshad pa'i mjug tu/ yang na zhes phyag rgya chen po'i lugs bkod par mkhas grub rin po che ma dgyes nas mtshungs med rje la khyod la yang na sogs kyi bshad pa yod ces bsgyur byang dang bcas mjal kha ma btang / de nyid kyis kyang ngan rtsom zhig mdzad (155na rdzas phyir byon tshul chos skang yid kyi mdzes rgyan du gsal ba ltar yin pas rje bla ma nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen la gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs dgos rigs su 'dug /rje bla ma nas rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshor brgyud pa'i srol 'di sngon chad ma grags shing bzhed phugs dbu ma'i lta ba yin par phyag chen la thun mong ma yin pa'i gtsigs su mdzad mi 'thad/ klu sgrub lugs kyi lta ba thun mong ma yin pa de ga yin na de la phyag chen gyi ming yang 'dogs pa'i dgos pa lhag po mi 'dug /nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bka' nas brgyud pa las 'os med kyang da lta spyi ming sgos la btags te dwags po bka' brgyud dang shangs pa bka' brgyud ces zur du 'byed par snang / sa skya pa rnams kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa zer ba las sa skya bka' brgyud du mi 'dogs pa bzhin rang re'i bstan pa 'di la'ang dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes pa 'di gas chog /dga' ldan bka' brgyud ces bka' brgyud pa'i gras su phar 'tshangs pa 'di la dge mtshan med ces gsung bar snang ba bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu de dag gi dgongs pa zhe phugs rtogs par mi nus pas kha mtshon —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negasang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgya che ba bka' ma dang zab pa gter ma gnyis kyi skor/gnyis pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi skor la rgya che ba bka' ma dang zab pa gter ma gnyis/dang po ni/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud bde stong sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi snying po'i bcud bsdus shing ye shes gsang ba la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bcu gsum/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ ye shes rdzogs pa/ klong dgu pa/ ye shes bdun 'byung / nya mo 'khor lo/ rgya mtsho sgron ma/rnyog pa med pa/ snying po don rgyud/ rig pa nam mkha' ltar gsal ba/ mdo lnga snying po/ mkha' dang mnyam pa/ phyi ma'i phyi ma rnams/rdo rje'i zam pa dbang gi man ngag la sogs pa'i sgrub sde bcu gsum/ 'phrul gyi me long brtsegs pa/ zam pa chung ngu / rin po che'i 'od/snang ba 'od/ gsal ba 'od/ 'gro drug g.yang sa bcad pa/ rin po che'i bra kṛ ta/ rna (157na〉brgyud tshig gsum/ lam gyi dpe bzhi/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gdams pa/ rna brgyud lung 'phreng / rin po che gser 'phreng rnams/ lta ba'i klong la sogs pa klong dgu'i sgom pa'i klong / spyod pa'i klong / 'bras bu'i klong / sa lam gyi klong /dkyil 'khor gyi klong / dbang gi klong / dam tshig gi klong /'phrin las kyi klong rnams/don gyi bcud byung rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po snyan brgyud rdo rje'i zam pa zhes theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtser gyur pa 'di nyid 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu lo chen bee ro tsa nas mkhas pa shrī sidha sogs rgya gar gyi pan chen nyi shu rtsa lnga'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod brtol ba'i gdams pa zab mo la brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum las phyi ma'i skor bee ro'i 'dra 'bag tu/ bdag nyid bee ro tsa na mchis pa 'di/ /yang dag bcu gcig don dang ye nas ldan/ /rgya gar yul nas cho me bslabs nas/ /sgra don bsdebs nas bka' bsgyur te/ /bod kyi rgyal khamasadakar por btang / /rgyal dang blon po kun log nas/ /sprugs pas tsha ba'i rong du mchis/ khyud sde klong sde'i bka' bkrol bas/ /g.yu sgra snying po nyid la gtad/ /tsha ba'i rgyal khams dkar por btang / /—224

dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ 'di yan brda brgyud/ lo tsā ba chen po bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ dgung lo sum brgya dang drug cu btsos/dpang mi pham mgon po/ rten khyim pa/ dgung lo lnga brgya/ kyi gsung sgros thor bu zhal slob rnams kyis reg zig tu btab pa jo bo stan gcig pa dpal 'byor bzang pos 'khrid yig gi go rim dang bstun bsgrigs par rje btsun nyid kyi dngos slob gsang phu ba chos rgyal bas dag ther mdzad pa/ chos 'di'i nyamasachags skong ba'i rtsa ba glang po che rab 'bogs kyi rgyud las bkol ba'i dri med bshags rgyud kyi lha dang khon gcugs bshags pa'i le'u zur du phyung ba lta ba'i klong bshags ye shes sku mchog /de'i bshad thabs rje btsun bsam gling pa'i dngos slob zhal phu ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ rdzogasapa chen po phyi skor nang skor gsang skor gsang ba bla na med pa rnams kyi rnam par dbye ba gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pas bsam gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams kyi bzhed pa ltar tshogs chen po dpal 'gror bzang pos mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa chen po phyi skor gyi gzhung don gsal byed gsham na gangs ri'i khrod kyi lam rdzogs pa zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod pa/ 'di mnya med 'a po'i gsung yin na mo snyam/ rje btsun bsam gling pa'i gsung rgyun re kha (165na)nag po dang dri med 'od zer gyi 'char tshul/ ga rma pa kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i a ti phyi skor gyi 'khrid yig tshigs bcad ma/ 'di nyid la ga lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi bag chags sad pa'i nyams ngo mtshar ba zhig snang bas gang gi yang srid du grags pa'i mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang 'dra ba ni min no/ /zab chos 'di'i bshad khungs yang —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhedag rtsa ba/ slob dpon hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa'i ru lu 'bru brgyad gser 'phreng thugs kyi lde mig /zab chos 'di'i bshad khungs phur pa rtsa dum/ a ti 'di sa skya 'khon gyi yab chos yang phur gnyis kyi rdzogs rim zab pa'i mthar thug yin pas/ gnad de ma go bar sde pa snang rtse bas 'di'i sgos dbang yin zhes yang phur gyi byin rlabs nyung ngu zhig brtsams pa sogs bzlog pa dang gong ra ba sogs spel gyi yod 'dug pa ni nang zong phyir ston no/ /mnyam med bsam gling pa'i gsung rgyun bzhin gsang phu chos rgyal bas mdzad pa'i phur pa rtsa dum gyi bshad rgyun zin bris/ rje btsun bsam gling pa'i gsung rgyun phur pa stod las kyi don 'grel/ mnyam med chen por mnal lam du lhas gnang ba byin par brten nas mdzad pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi bstod pa/ sing gha la'i slob dpon hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa'i bum rmugs lung ngam dpal yang gsang sgrub pa'i bkol byang / rje btsun bsam gling pas zab don 'di la 'jug pa'i skyes bu yid ches slad lung tshad ma bka' bstan bcos kun las btus par bar bar du gnad kyi 'tshams sbyor yod pa'i zab mo lung gi 'phreng ba zhes lung sbyor chung ba/ tshogs chen pa dpal 'byor bzang pos (165bsgo nyam med chen po'i drung du gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi lung dang dka' gnad gsan pa rnams kyi steng du zhal slob g.yin gyi zin bris rnams kyang bsnan nas bsgrigs pa'i lung sbyor che bar grags pa rnams/bzhi pa rtsa gsum las byang dang chos srungs skor la/ rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang zhes pa rang nyid gza' rgod sgyid rengs su bsgoms nas bstan ma bcu gnyis dang mon bu pu ra spun gnyis la 'phrin las 'chol ba/ gnubs chen gyi gsung sgros 'khor lo rnam lnga'i gnad gal che tshul bstan pa/ gur mgon gyi bskang ba las nye bar ba yis pa'i 'dra rung gcig /nā ga kā la'i gnad kyi man ngag /stan gcig pa dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa'i ma mo sbod gtong gi rnam bshad gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me yid kyi mun sel/ rje btsun chen pos rtsa gsum las byang gi gsal byed lag len mdor dril ba/ yang phur sgrags ma'i sgrub thabs ma mo spod gtong ngam sde brgyad 'o dod ma'am bde gshegs—236

myong med/ reg bral/ cho 'phrul rnams kyi sgo nas grol ba'i dbang / bod yig sum cu rim par nyen mongs grol ba/ 'khor ba las grol ba/ ma chags shing rnam par dag pa/mtshan ma las rgyal ba/ mtshan 'dzin
