'khor ba'i mya ngan 'dul ba/ gzhal yas khang bde ba chen po/ ma rig mun sel/ rang bzhin med par sgra sgrog pa/ gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don byed/ nyon mongs gcod pa/ sems can don byed gsum/ kyi cho ga sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pas sna drangs/ lha lnga ma/ bcu ma/ bco lnga ma/ dgu bcu rtsa gcig ma/ dgu bcu rtsa dgu ma/ brgya nyer lnga ma rnams lha gcig pa mang ba'i dbang gis dbang chog nag 'gros su bldabs pa mi 'dug rung / phyag len la so so'i dkyil 'khor dang mthun pa'i lha dbang yongs rdzogs/ rdzas dbang la dbu rgyan gyis chos kyi rgyal tshab / yum gyi phyag rgyas nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba/ seng phrug zung gis rgol ba zil gnon/ glang phrug zung gis 'jig rten 'degs pa/ kā shi'i ras kyis ye shes gsal ba/ bum chus nyon mongs bag chags dag pa/ ming gis shes bya la ma rmongs pa/ rgyan gyis 'gro kun shes par ldan pa/ yig shing gis cho sgo sgra sgrog pa/gnam rus bdud dpung 'joms pa/ btsun mos rigs mi nub pa/ shing rtas skye rga na 'pha sdug bsngal sun phyung ba/ chibs kyis rab tu pa 'og ma dang 'brel ba'i smin grol rdzogs nas/ gsang sngags phyi kṛ ya'i theg pa la/rigs gsum so so'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ de gsum po re re gtso bo byas pa la kṛ ya don gyi lha drug gis bskor ba'i dkyil 'gros su bldabs pa mi 'dug rung / phyag len la so so'i dkyil 'khor dang mthun pa'i lha dbang yongs rdzogs/ rdzas dbang la dbu rgyan gyis chos kyi rgyal tshab / yum gyi phyag rgyas nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba/ seng phrug zung gis rgol ba zil gnon/ glang phrug zung gis 'jig rten 'degs pa/ kā shi'i ras kyis ye shes gsal ba/ bum chus nyon mongs bag chags dag pa/ ming gis shes bya la ma rmongs pa/ rgyan gyis 'gro kun shes par ldan pa/ yig shing gis chos sgra sgrog pa/gnam rus bdud dpung 'joms pa/ btsun mos rigs mi nub pa/ shing rtas skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal sun phyung ba/ chibs kyis rab tu 'byung zhing nyen (174na tshe rgongs las grol/ ral gris nyone mongs dra ba gcod pa/ gseg par gyis 'gro don mthar phyin/ na bza' ngur smig gis srid pa'i gdung skyob/ 'bras chen gyis mtshan dpe rab brjid/ rtsa'i stan gyis bdud kyis mi tshugs pa/ bu ram sbrang rtsis 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ste sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa nyi shu dang sbyar ba'i dbang / lam khyer la/theg pa byang sems theg pa/ lha thub dbang dang yum chen mor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang semasakyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu/ sngags mu ni dang pa ra ga te/ dbang mdzad pa nyi shu/ dang sgom 'jug sgo bden pa gnyis/ lta ba bdag med gnyis/ bsrung bya byang sems sdom pa/ spyod pa bdag gzhan mnyam brje/ tshul khrims mi dge bcu spong / dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed/ 'bras bu sa bcu bgrod nas sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan no/ /theg pa 'og ma dang 'brel ba'i smin grol rdzogs nas/ gsang sngags phyi kṛ ya'i theg pa la/rigs gsum so so'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ de gsum po re re gtso bo byas pa la kṛ ya don gyi lha drug gis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ steng du rnam snang lha lnga ma/ bar du 'od dpag med lha lnga ma/—248

mdzad/slob dpon shākya bo dhi/ dge slong so kya de ba/ slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rje/ mas blon de ba/ mkhan po chos rgyal skyong / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che/ lung a nu yo ga'i brgyud pa ni/ kun gyis nga rgyal gyi mtha' la gnas pa rnams/ padma he ru ka yab yum gyisa'adod chags kyi mtha' la gnas pa rnams/ kurma he ru ka yab yum gyis phrag dog gi mtha' la gnas pa rnams/ go ris srid gsum gyi sdug bsngal gtan 'joms/ tso ris thugs rje 'gro don mdzad pa/pra mo has khams gsum gyi bdud las rgyal ba/ bee ta lis rnam par rtog pa 'dul ba/ pun sis log rtog bde chen du 'dren pa/ ghasma ris snod bcud ma lus gsol ba/ sma sha nis 'gro ba sdug bsngal las sgrol ba/ tsaṇḍali sa las nyon sdom pa/ seng gdong mas log lta zil gnon/ stag gdong mas rnam rtog dbyings su za ba/ wa gdong mas thabs shes kyi spyan thob pa/ spyang gdong mas las nyon za ba/ bya rgod gdong mas thams cad bsnyeg pa/ (186na tha ka mu khas srid gsum dbang sdud/ bya rog gdong mas rnam rtog rdul du rlog pa/ 'ug gdong mas ma rig mun pa sel ba/ lcags kyu ma'i byams thugasakyis bde chen dbyings su 'dren pa/ zhags pa ma'i snying rjes rnam rtog dang mtshan ma 'ching ba/ lcags sgrog ma'i dga' bas log lta chos nyid du sdom pa/ dril la thog mar bgegs kha dang sdig pa bsal nas rigs drug gi gnas sbyangs te bcud bzang po sdugs par snod la byi dor byed pa ltar gyi rjes su/ bdag don rdo rje slob ma'i dbang la rin po che'i dbu rgyan ze phyog lnga pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang sems can lus sul po phyag na rdo rjes zug rngu bsal ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ gsang bdag gi skus byang chub snying po can du gyur —273—

ru bzlog pa'i man ngag /nyon mongs pa'i ro chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba'i man ngag bee ro tsa na'i thugs kyi gting du sbas pa rgyal mo g.yu sgras (198'ag pas gter nas phyung ba/ 'phung mkhan ngos bzung zhing 'khrul gzhi rtsad gcad pa bee ro tsa nas g.yu sgra snying po la bcud kyi dwangs ma brnag pa'i gter du gtad pa/ 'jam dpal la bshes gnyen rig pa rang shar gyi man ngag /rdzong 'phrang gi yon to bshad pa/ mtshan ma zil gnon gyi dgongs pa/ bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gung shing dgu la thag bcad pa'i man ngag /slob dpon padmas rgan mo dge ldan ma dang g.yog mo rin chen 'tsho la gdams pa rgan mo mdzub btsugs/ dbang gi nges tshig chu bo bzhi'i babs tshul/ snang srid bzhi bzhengs kyi dgongs pa/ rin po che shel gyi khang bu'i dgongs pa/ chosathams cad kyi snying po rig pa spyi blugs kyi dgongs pa/ khams gsum rang grol gyi dgongs pa/ 'da' kha tshig gsum gyi dgongs pa bsgom du med pa'i mchog /za 'og be khyim gyi dgongs pa/ nam mkha' slong yangs kyi dgongs pa/ yid bzhin gter khyim rang gi sems la rdzogs pa khams gsum yongs grol gyi dgongs pa/ byang chub kyi sems dus bzhi rnal 'byor gyi dgongs pa/ me long g.ya' dag gi dgongs pa shel dkar bza' yang grol ba/ mkhas pa bzhis dzñā na la gtad pa'i rgya mtsho klong yangs kyi dgongs pa/ srid gsum rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med kyi dgongs pa/ gsang ba'i don ston yul sems gnyis med kyi dgongs pa/ snying po byang chub rig pa rang shar gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pa pad ma thod 'phreng gis (198ba khru rabs don du bzhag pa/ bsam gtan zas kyi rim pa/ dbyings dang ye shes rtogs pa nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dgongs pa/ lha'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid gsal ba'i sgo nas 'gro don bya thabs/ sbyor ba don gyi man ngag /sbyor sgrol gnyis kyi man ngag /lha mo pa rnye ka 'gugs par byed pa'i gdams ngag /lta spyod med du byung ba'i gsang sgo/ khams gsum 'khor ba sangs rgyas yin par yid —282

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebastan pa/ gzung ma'i mtshan nyid rigs lngar sems sbyang ba yid la brnag cing spyad par bya ba'i mtha' can/ 'khor ba btsan thabs su ru bzlog pa'i man ngag /nyon mongs pa'i ro chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba'i man ngag bee ro tsa na'i thugs kyi gting du sbas pa rgyal mo g.yu sgras (198na 'ag pas gter nas phyung ba/ 'phung mkhan ngos bzung zhing zhabrul gzhi rtsad gcad pa bee ro tsa nas g.yu sgra snying po la bcud kyi dwangs ma brnag pa'i gter du gtad pa/ 'jam dpal la bshes gnyen rig pa rang shar gyi man ngag /rdzong 'phrang gi yon to bshad pa/ mtshan ma zil gnon gyi dgongs pa/ bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gung shing dgu la thag bcad pa'i man ngag /slob dpon padmas rgan mo dge ldan ma dang g.yog mo rin chen 'tsho la gdams pa rgan mo mdzub btsugs/ dbang gi nges tshig chu bo bzhi'i babs tshul/ snang srid bzhi bzhengs kyi dgongs pa/ rin po che shel gyi khang bu'i dgongs pa/ chosathams cad kyi snying po rig pa spyi blugs kyi dgongs pa/ khams gsum rang grol gyi dgongs pa/ 'da' kha tshig gsum gyi dgongs pa bsgom du med pa'i mchog /za 'og be khyim gyi dgongs pa/ nam mkha' slong yangs kyi dgongs pa/ yid bzhin gter khyim rang gi sems la rdzogs pa khams gsum yongs grol gyi dgongs pa/ byang chub kyi sems dus bzhi rnal 'byor gyi dgongs pa/ me long g.ya' dag gi dgongs pa shel dkar bza' yang grol ba/ mkhas pa bzhis dzñā na la gtad pa'i rgya mtsho klong yangs kyi dgongs pa/ srid gsum rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med kyi dgongs pa/ gsang ba'i don ston yul sems gnyis med kyi dgongs pa/ snying po byang chub rig pa rang shar gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pa pad ma thod 'phreng gis (198ba khru rabs don du bzhag pa/ bsam gtan zas kyi rim pa/ dbyings dang ye shes rtogs pa nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dgongs pa/ lha'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid gsal ba'i sgo nas 'gro don bya thabs/ sbyor ba don gyi man ngag /sbyor sgrol gnyis kyi man ngag /lha mo pa rnye ka 'gugs par byed pa'i gdams ngag /lta spyod med du byung ba'i gsang sgo/ khams gsum 'khor ba sangs rgyas yin par yid —282

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)ches par byed pa'i man ngag slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa gnubs nam mkha'i snying po las brgyud pa/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtshos khu lung gi dben gnas su sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che la zhus pas dogs gcod 'da' kha ye shes kyi man ngag /slob dpon pad mas bslab pa'i mtha' gcig ma/ de dang 'dra min yang slob dpon pad mas mdzad pa'i bslab pa'i mtha' gcig ma/ lta ba shan 'byed gter bshad rtsal la gtad pa/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rang sems su thag bcad pa tha mas kyang zla ba ma nyams pa bcu drug gis las kyi 'phreng ba thob pa'i mtha' can/ gser la dgyes mi dgyes kyi log rtog la brton nas rang rig slob dpon gyi skur sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon padmas byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde btsan la gdams pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dbye ba'i sgo nas dbyer med pa'i don thugs su chud pa'i don man ngag gi gnad du bstan pa/ ma nor don rdzogs kyi sangs rgyas dang mngon du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi dbye ba/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom pa la zla ba spyi don gsum pa/ lta spyod kyi man ngag lo rgyus cung (199na)zad dbu na yod pa gter bzhad rtsal gyis rgyas btab pa'i mtha' can/ gnubs kyis snang srid chos thams cad rang sems su bstan pa man ngag shel gyi khang pa/ bsgom pa'i don mdor bsdus pa sems kyi gzhag sa bsten pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis legs pa'i rin po che la bka' gnang ba dgongs pa'i lung gtad pa'i rgya/ lta spyod med du byung ba dwa na yon tan mchog gi thugs kyi nying khu bzhu ba/ lho brag mkhar chur slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po tshomakhar chen bza'i don du bstan pa ting nge 'dzin gyi man ngag /bsam gtan lung gi man ngag /rdzogs pa chen po snying po 'phrul gyi me long / bod kyi mnga' bdag la man ngag brdzangs pa'i tho/ rang sems rtogs tsam dang dmigs pa phyogs gcig tu grub pas mi chog pa khyung phrug gi gshog pa'i dpe dang bcas pa/ stong gsum til 'bru che chung med pa sogs kyi dpe don/ dran pa dus mtshungs kyi dgongs pa/ mkhas pas sems lta bar gdams pa/ mtha' drug rdzogs dgos pa nang rtogs na nang 'tshang rgya ba nub rtogs na nub 'tshang rgya ba/ rin po che gser gyi thigs pa'i man ngag bcud phyung ba/—283—

gros/'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/'khon dkon cog rgyal po/'khon kun dga' snying po/'khon bsod nams rtse mo/'khon grags pa rgyal mtshan/gan pa ston dar/gan pa so ston/gan pa chos rgyal/gan pa rin rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegadams shog dril dkar po/ rdo zhun gyi zhal gdams nyer mkho bsdus pa gsal sgron/ tsha bze bdud rtsi me long / dngul sbyor gsang mnyam chen mo'i sbyor ba/ gdon bshal gnam lcags thog mda'/bse ru bzhi pa'i zhal gdams/ ril nag che 'bring chung gsum gyi gsang don gsal byed 'chi med nor bu rnams/ gnyis pa bu yig gi skor la/ dkar chag nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa la/ gtsug bshal sbyor ba bde ldan/ mgo srin gsob ya ma drungs 'byin/ 'dam ru'i man ngag /'dam chings 'phrul gyi rgya mdud/ zug rngu mde'i snyel brtag pa lcags rnga dbyug pa'i sbyor ba/ lnga bcom sha lhag myur 'joms/ ya ma drungs 'byin/ mgo rlung gi bcos gu gul nag po'i sbyor ba/ chu nad kyi sgos (211nang khyos/ za phrug gi bcos/ rta bong gi pa dang skrangs rnag brtag pa gsal ba'i me long rta bsrung pho mo khyu tsho/ tshal 'phrul bshal/ mkhris pa'i gser sbyongs/ drag po bzhi sbyor/ bdud rtsi ming can gyi sbyor ba/ mgo rlung gi bcos bdud ngan bcos pa/ yan lag rma bcos/ tshigs shong bcos pa/ dug bcos/ thig le nyams pa bcos pa/ dngas ma 'phel ba/ chang nad bcos pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong sman dkon cog phan dar nas rim par/ sems dpa' rpā po/ drang srong bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ de sras drang srong dar rgyas/ sman sgom ngag dbang don grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa rṣa (213na)po/des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /'brum nad sngags 'chos nyams kyi yig chung zab pa sa snying gi dkyil 'khor du cho nges kyi mtha' can gyi brgyud pa ni/ shong chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar du/ 'chi med grub pa'i dzo gis sgo nyal byas/ /sngon du byas pa'i bag chags gsal bar dran/ /gnas gsar gu ru ma hā ta pa si/ 'phagasayul skye bo phal cher thal mo sbyor/ /zhes pa ltar/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs dgung lo bcu bdun gyi tshe rgya gar nub phyogs nā gi rko ṭa'i rgyal po sras ma ṇi ka nā tha zhes bya ba 'chi med grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byon nas ngas gu ru 'tshol ba la lan gsum yongs pa'i snga ma'i dus ma'i rum na byas pas ma mthong / bar ma byis pa chung ngu zhig skyes pa zhig gis bzung nas 'dug pa rgyang nas mthong / da lam phrad pa 'di yin gsungs/ o rgyan padma sku gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang / a bhi dha nar gsungs pa'i phag mo'i byin rlabs dang bhu rlung sogs gdams pa mang du gnang zhing / slob dpon padma'i sku za hor ma rgya bzo rtsod med cig 'dug pa gzigs pas gu ru rgyal po lugs dpe har gyis bod du sprul zer ba dang / bla sgrub ratna gling pa'i gter ma dang khyad mi 'dug pas gter brdzus ma yin zer ba rnams kyi rdzun khungs rnams rdib ste gsang sngags rnying ma la thugs lhag par ches shing ratna gling pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phros don las gsal ba/ gsar 'gyur o rgyan zab lam sku (213ba)gsum bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung la nang gses kyi rang byung rdzus skyes chos sku mthing nag gi sgrub —303—

sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar du/ 'chi med grub pa'i dzo gis sgo nyal byas/ /sngon du byas pa'i bag chags gsal bar dran/ /gnas gsar gu ru ma hā ta pa si/ 'phagasayul skye bo phal cher thal mo sbyor/ /zhes pa ltar/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs dgung lo bcu bdun gyi tshe rgya gar nub phyogs nā gi rko ṭa'i rgyal po sras ma ṇi ka nā tha zhes bya ba 'chi med grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byon nas ngas gu ru 'tshol ba la lan gsum yongs pa'i snga ma'i dus ma'i rum na byas pas ma mthong / bar ma byis pa chung ngu zhig skyes pa zhig gis bzung nas 'dug pa rgyang nas mthong / da lam phrad pa 'di yin gsungs/ o rgyan padma sku gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang / a bhi dha nar gsungs pa'i phag mo'i byin rlabs dang bhu rlung sogs gdams pa mang du gnang zhing / slob dpon padma'i sku za hor ma rgya bzo rtsod med cig 'dug pa gzigs pas gu ru rgyal po lugs dpe har gyis bod du sprul zer ba dang / bla sgrub ratna gling pa'i gter ma dang khyad mi 'dug pas gter brdzus ma yin zer ba rnams kyi rdzun khungs rnams rdib ste gsang sngags rnying ma la thugs lhag par ches shing ratna gling pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phros don las gsal ba/ gsar 'gyur o rgyan zab lam sku (213ba)gsum bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung la nang gses kyi rang byung rdzus skyes chos sku mthing nag gi sgrub —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa/rdo rje bsrung ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sgrub pa/mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul sku'i sgrub pa/dpal mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum sgrub pa'i 'grel pa lo rgyus gdams skor dngos dang bcas pa rje btsun nub phyogs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la brten nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su mdzad pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/grub chen dza ha pir/rje btsun nub phyogs pa ma ṇi ka nā tha/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/mchod dpon dkon cog pa/khyab bdag dbang phyug ros brtan/kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/drin ༅ bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o/bhu rlung gi gdams pa zab mo rje btsun nub phyogs pa'i gsung bzhin 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su mdzad pa'i lung /phyag len/zhal shes rnams dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/grub chen dza ha pir/rje btsun bhra ma nā tha/rje btsun nub phyogs pa ma ṇi kun tha/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/sngags 'chang gzhen nu stobs ldan/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan chen zha lu pa khyab bdag rin cen bsod na mas mchogo grub/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang na rje mkhyen ba tshe nas/'phags mchoge byams pa skal bzang /rje dbang rab man sngar bzhin no/rje btsun nub phyogs pas gnang ba'i yang ldan rdo rjes gnang ba'i tshe dbang nye brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/mgon po tshe dpag med/mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes/slob dpon padma thod 'phreng /grub brnyes dpal ldan rdo rje/thams cad mkhyen pa kha rlang thu le pa gsum yod

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yag ga rnyi chu rgyun las gleg bam gnya pa/ yob)pa'i nang nas/o rgyan padma saṃ bha wa la dngos su gsan pa'i tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i tshe'i dbang mda' 'phel mar grags pa'i chog sgrigs mkhan chen zha lu pas mdzad pa'i 'chi med 'byung ba'i steng nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs te bskyed rim gsal btab nas gzungs bzla ba/rdzogs rim du bsdus te sngags bzla ba/bskyed rim du langs nas tshe 'gugs pa/bum pa la brten nas tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i dbang /zhan byung tshe dang ye shes thams cad bstim pa/mtha' rten rgyal srid bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang bcas pa/lha bstim pa/tshe gzan/tshe ril gyi dbang /dbang chog 'chi med 'byung ba'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med/slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ras kho dpal 'byor bzang po/de la chos rje rnam rgyal mgon po dri med sde dang /'jam dbyangs byang tso dbang rgyal gnyi gas gsan/gnyi ga la yongs 'dzin shākya kun 214bdag 'a/de nas mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/rig 'dzin kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang po/mkhas grub shākya rdo rje/mdo pa mtshungs med dge ba'i dbang po/rme khan chen zha lu pa rin byu bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang na ras rṣa pa nas/rngog ston byang chub dpal grub/rje btsun shī la ra smi/rnam rgyal mgon po/byang chub dbang rgyal man gong ltar ro//gsang ba'i lung bstan las/yang zhig gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes nye ne//da lta lha srasayab yum sras bcas kyi//sku yi rim gro bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang //drag spyod mthu yi rgol ba phyir bzlog nas//bar chad bsal zhing yon mchod we po ba'i mthus//ma 'o nges bzhi brtser dus mtshungasa'abyung bar nges//smon lam dbang gis chos 'di rnams phrad la//dmar rgyan bza' yi sprul pa 'dzam gling ming //ga pa'i rtags bzhi tshang des ma bslus na//dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i chos bdag nyer gcig ste//rgyal sras lha rje'i skye ba lug lo pa//mchog dang ma ṇi'i ming can dam pa ni//rig 'dzin sngags kyi bdag por yongs kyis bskur//'gro ༷'i mgon po kun tu snang bar byed//de nyid bdud

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhesprul dbang gis skra bcad na/ /lo skor gcig gi tshe nyams bstan pa 'grib/ /slad nas sngags 'chang lcang lo 'dzin pa gces/ /skyes bu de la zab mo kun 'dus kyi/ /gdams pa 'di ni yongs su rdzogasapa gtod/ /ces pa ltar gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi yang srid rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas sam 'ja' tshon me 'bar dang mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rtsal du grags pa'i (215na gter skal rtsa gsum zab mo kun 'dus kyi skor bdud po bla mkhar gyi sgo drung g.yas par gter du sbas pa lung bstan bzhin rten 'brel cung zad 'phyugs pas shog ser dngos ma lon yang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gros rdzogs par gnang ba'i chos skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog rgyan gyi 'bor lo'i steng nas zab mo kun 'dus kyi rtsa ba'i dbang la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog 'phreng ba/ zhing khams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor khyams gcig tu rdzogs pa/ bum pas snod rung / rtsa gsum sku 'bag gis sku/ glegs bam bdud rtsi'i pi waṃ gis gsung / man shel/kha ṭaṃ me long gis thugs/ gtor mas yon tan/ phur pas 'phrin las kyi dbang / mtha' rten rgyal srid bdun rdzas dang bcas pa/ dbang chog bde chen myur mgyogs kyi steng nas byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / phyag rgya la brten nas sher dbang zung 'jug tu bskur ba dang bcas pa rasabris kyi dkyil 'khor du smin grol 'od kyi 'khor lo'i steng nas tshe bdag lha bdun ma'i dbang la/gsol gdab zhu 'bul tshe 'gugs sngon du 'gro ba'i cod pan/ bum pa yid dam sku 'bag gis rdo rje gsum gyi tshe dbang / thod 'phreng rtsal gyis ka dag 'gyur med kyi tshe dbang / lha tu gnas pa'i tshe dbang / tshe long gis bskyed rim/ 'phreng bas bzlas pa/ mda' dar gyis rdzogos rim/ rjes(215ba)dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa/ 'ja' tshon 'od kyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du rtsa gsum dril ba ldem dgongs kyi yi ge'i steng nas skra dbang la 'jug pa dang thun mong gi chos sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong ma —306

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (khanapa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin dbang sgrub kyi dus byung ba'i rdo rje rgya mdud kyi dbang bzhi tshe sgrub thams cad kyi snying po/ rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /lung bstan dri med gdung sel las/ /zab mo don bsdus snying (220bajo 'di/ /lha ri rin —3/3

mkha' 'gro'i dag snang / rtsa ba'i ngo sprod tshig rkang (222nang cu bzhi ma gzhung 'grel (nyi)'od gsal rtse mo'i rgyan/ sgom med nam mkha'i 'khor lo nges don rig pa'i mthol glu/ dbyings rig 'ja' zer gyi thig le skye med chos sku'i ngo sprod chen mo gab sbas kyi yang rtse/dbang chog rdo rje snying po rdzogs rṣa 9)gsang ba'i ngo sprod rig pa rtsal dbang gung du sbas pa/ dngosagazhi'i dag snang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ngo sprod padma 'od kyi dra ba'i zhing bkod/ padma dra ba'i gling gi smon lam ḍā gi rol pa rnam gsum rnams/ bzhi pa bogs 'don la/ mun 'khrid 'ja' lus zang thal u dum wa ra'i me tog gsang chen snying po ngo sprod lag bcangs ma/ mun 'khrid gsol 'debs lhun grub mdangs lnga ma/ phag mo'i las byang zag med bde chen/ phag mo'i skong bshags sgrib gnyis rang grol/ phag mo'i sbyin sreg las bzhi myur 'grub/ gtum mo bde chen padma'i gru rdzings/ de'i gsola'adebs beeḍūrla'i chu rgyun/ 'byul 'khor gsal ba'i chu rgyun/ 'og sgo'i gdams pa yang zab bde chen rgya mtsho/ phag mo'i rdzogs rim chos dbyings sgyu ma'i snying thig /zab don snying po rmi lam 'od gsal gyi 'khrid gzhung / de'i 'grel pa nyi zla'i bla re/ spyod yul dpa' bo'i 'thol glu/ de'i 'grel pa gsal byed/ mkho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod rdo rje'i lam chen chos dbyings thar gling gru gzings/ 'pho ba'i man ngag zab khyad can/ thems med/ bar do 'ja' phud rang grol rnams/ lnga pa lung bstan la/ phyi'i lung bstan shel gyi me long / nang gi lung bstan nyi 'od rab gsal/ gsang ba'i lung bstan me bya yan gyi bstan pa gso thabs/ thang lha'i lung dri med (222ba)'od kyi gdung (nyi)sel o rgyan gsung gi brda 'grol rnams/ drug pa nyams 'og chud nges pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal me ga'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sngags 'chang stod grong pa/ zur (233bcu ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bon gyi bla chen dran pa nam mkha' khyung lung dngul mkhar du thams cad zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa'i dus ā tsarla nag pos zhag bdun gyi dus btab par mkha' 'gro thugs rje kun grol gyis gnang ba'i byad kha thams cad bzlog pa'i yig rgod chang khrus ma'i brgyud pa ni/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'/ o rgyan chen po nas rim par/ chos rgyal me ga'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' ma lugs kyi rang lo la brten pa'i dag bsrung —332

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ sgob)ḍā ki bsu bzlog las sgrib shing khol du phyung ba/ byang chub sems pa ha nu marsha'i sgo nas thig le bsrung ba/ sprel gzugs la brten nas mi kha dang sdang ba zhi byed rnams kyi lung phyag len kyang rtsa ba'i bla masayab zur chen la gsan pa yin no/ /bdud bzlog nag po 'bru bdun zhes pa yang bzlog a thur nag po'i brgyud pa ni/ rje zur pa/bkra shis rgya mtsho/ du ma rang grol/ gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de bdag la'o/ /phra men phyin ci log gi ngag 'grol rus sbal sprel mgo bya lag sbrul mjug can gyi 'khor lo/ dbang phyug la brten nas 'od glo bur bzlog pa rnams kyang thob/ 'byum bsrung stag gzig ma ma bu zhal shesabacas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar slob dpon bee ro tsa nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs nas (234na na drangs pa'i btags chog 'khor lo nyes kun sel zhing 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa'i lung phyag bzhes zur rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid la thob bo/ /sman gyi lha mo dang gnod sbyin dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha par zhus/ des lan bu a mi la gsan no/ /sngags chu la brten pa'i legs nyes bsam pa gang yin kyang bsgyur thabs nad pa gso ba'i gza' mdos gyer gzhung drang srong chen po'i skyes rabs rnam thar lho brag mkhar chu'i gter ma/ khro bo dmar po'i zhabs 'og gi gter ma lo tsā ba tha ba ri pa'i man ngag grib kyi rigs bsrung ba lag pa'i 'du byed bskyod pa mthib srin rtse sprad/ bshan pa ro langs kyi rtsar phyin kyang gnod mi nus pa'i lag pa'i 'du byed bskyod pa mdzub mo rnams kyi rtser me tog yod pa/ lag pa'i 'du byed bskyod pa mthar rten 'brel snying pos bskor ba'i grib kyi rigs thams cad thub pa/ yang na mo ratna tru wā yas sna drangs te bskor ba'i grib kyis mi gnod par dngos grub tu 'gyur ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin du stsal to/ /—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bstan dgra 'phung byed thal ba'i gdams skor la/dbang phyug chen po la brten pa'i gnod byed bskrad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya'i ha spun dmar po rdzas rgod nag po sngags kyi la dor ba'i mtha' can/ka ta la'i zhal gdams gnad dmigs logs su gab pa lo rgyus gzhan du yod do'i mtha' can/'phung bshig rag 'gyel thal ba rlung khyer ā tsarla dzu nag pos 234ba / drag po 'phung byed kyi rgyud nas btus shing ston pa a ba seng shes zla gsang nag po sprel lag can gyi nang nas khol du byung ba spu gri so can rgya mtsho'i chu rdo bzhin du spos shig gi mtha' can/ka ta la'i zhal gdams zla gsang ha la nag po'i rgyud nas rdzas 'khor lo sngags bca' gzhi thun tshod che chung grangs sogs bstan pa zab phyir rin cen gter du sbas lugs so'i mtha' can rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ā tsarla dzu nag/ston pa a wa seng ge/de nas rim par brgyud de gnubs kyi sngags 'chang sku bsrung ba rgyal mtshan lhun grub/gnubs kyi sngags nag mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun bzang dpal 'byor/rje btsun mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/mtshudas med 'phrin las lhun grub/drin can gter bdag gling pa/des bdag la'o//dar sdings pa'i gsan yig tu 'di gter ma zhig yin 'dug kyang gter ston dang gter gnas khungs ma chod/bya ba sku bsrung ba dang 'brug pa padma dkar pos phyag tu bkal pa'i zab khyad ma yin 'dug tshul snang ba/la stod dmar po'i 'phung byed kyi thal dang phyogs 'dra tsam 'dug kyang rgyas bsdus sogs mi gcig pas gter du sbas zer ba rgya gar lta bur sbas pa dang /bod du dzo gi zhig gis bsnams byon pa yin nam snyam mo//'phung bshig yungs dar ma shin tu zab cing rno ba'i lung brgyud ni/sna phung dkon cog bzang po nas rim par/yug rdzong yab sras gnyis/dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug/zur thams 235na lod mkhyen pa/chos gter 'phrin las lhun grub/drin can gter bdag gling pa/des bdag la'o//gri rgyud la brten pa'i jag chings zab khyad ma'i lung brgyud ni/lha btsun kong spyon chen mo/4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (kha)mtshungs med 'phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /lag len 'di la brten nas rdzogs chen pa kun bzang rnam rgyal dpon slob kyis lcags sprul gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse sogs dmag gis bskor ba'i dus zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bdun gyi nyin dmag dpung gi dkyil gshags nas byon pa'i lag khyer ma'o/ /dar mdud la brten nas mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa las rab tu rgyal ba'i man ngag lag len ma'i lung phyag bzhes kyi brgyud pa ni/ bya'i sngags 'chang bkra shis dar rgyas/ bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' snying po/ yug rdzong nor bu dbang rgyal/ de sras rab brtan dbang po/ grub wo kun dga' rdo rje/mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /rgya gar gyi wa rti bya ba'i brag sked kyi lo rgyus las 'phros pa'i gson 'dre kha chings ma dha ka/gza' bsrung ni lo wa ra ma/ khyi dkar sna dmar gyi khrag la brten pa'i rgyal bsrung zab khyad ma dang bcas pa'i lung ni/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ 'phrin las lhun grub/ gter bdag gling pa/ desabadag la'o/ /dmar zhabs lugs kyi ser bsrung la/ lo rgyus rgyas pa/ chos 'byung gsum bsnol ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa/(235ba por byung chu sgyur gyi spel tshig dang bcas pa deng sang phyag len du mdzad pa'i shin tu zab pa/ yang ā tsarla dmar po'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ sngags la brten pa'i gdong bzlog /phur pa lnga'i thog bsrung / rdo 'khor/ bre sngags/ rdzas srung rdo 'khor mu khyud lnga pa'i bri yig /yang ser bsrung gdong bzlog dang 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i bri thabs 'dra min dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ā tsarla dmar po/ nyang stod ye shes4ra/ chag lo tsā ba/ sgom pa byang rdor/ slob dpon rgyal ba dbang phyug mgon/ dge slong phywa dhwa dza/ dha'i mtshan can/ rab 'byams chos rje/ chos rgyal nor ba/ gu ru grags pa/ kun dga' rdo rje/ rje mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ mtshungs med 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /—333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shemu stegs kyi sngags rgod la brten nas ser ba bsrung thabs kha nas thon chog ma rbad kham can gyi brgyud pa ni/ dpal sdings rab 'byams pa/ yug rdzong nor bu dbang rgyal/ dang ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ grub chen kun dga' rdo rje/ mkhas grub bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mtshungs med 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ser ba bsrung ba'i gdams pa spu gri skor gsum zhes pa rdzas gsag cing bsnyen pa/ gta' bsdam zhing sprin brtag pa/ ting 'dzin brtan zhing sngags bzla ba gsum gyi bstan pa/ gzhan yang ser srung gi man ngag thor bu la/ mi kha'i rdzas la brten nas ser sri mnan thabs rgyun chod cig gi mtha' can/ padma 'dab bzhi la brten nas (236na thar lam bcad cing ba dmar mo'i 'o ma la brten pa'i ser lam sreg pa byas pas chog go'i mtha' can/ ra rog gi thod pa la brten nas ser lam gcod thabs khyi lud kyis rdzib po'i mtha' can/ sprin brtag thabs dmigs pa gsal ba gal che'i mtha' can/ khyung gi ting 'dzin la brten nas nam mkha' rgyas 'debs thog gi nyes pa thub po'i mtha' can/sngags nus 'phrog pa'i zas kyi spang bya dang bcos thabs/ khyung po'i rus sbal gyi sngags ni ra sing dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad la brten pa'i nam mkha' rgyas 'debs rnams/ sha thod la brten nas ser lam gcod pa'i gdams pa mi rus mi gcig pa dgu'i skra dang sen mo bsre zhes pa'i mtha' can/ drag po lha bzhi'i rgyud las lo chog gi smreng dpal chen ha ya ma/ tho gsol dkon cog gsum ma/ ser bsrung le tshan 'di rnams rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub kyi grong sngags pa 'dra la gsan pas brgyud pa ba ded ma rnyed/ de nas gter ston rig 'dzin chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /grub thob skal ldan rgyal po'i gdams pa spyang zhi'i pags par brten nas ser khongs bcu gsum bsrung ba'i gdams pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i gdong bzlog thug phrad raka kra mā ra ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ dkar po kun dga' grags pa/ bla ma bsam grags pa/ dkar po ba bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med man mu stegs sngags rgod kyi de dang gcig go /—336

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig ga rnyi chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ba)nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin tsho gos 'dus nas gtor sngags gser zho re'i bka' rgya ma/(236ba)ser bsrung shing gi ral gri ma gnyis pha jo dung ngu bar rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub kyis gsan/de nas gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gshin rje nag po'i thog ser bsrung ba'i man ngag gi las mtha' la las mkhan mon pa nag pos ser sri mnan cing ser lam gcod pa sbal gzugs la brten pa/ g.yag grus rog po'i rwa g.yas par brten nas ser ba bsrung ba gshin rje chu thig gi rgyud nas btus pa/ zlog byed gur nag rgyud nas slo bur skad cig la ser ba bsrung ba sgrub pa bum 'khyil ma bram ze nag pos slob dpon padma la phul ba/ 'gor oṃ pa li'u shan zhes yod pa'i seng khog mas ser lam gcod thabs/ khyi thod la brten nas ser ba gcod cing ser sri mnan thabs 'khor lo mu khyud gsum pa'i kha sgyur lugs dang bcas pa rnams nyang yab sras kyi phyag len khungs mar grags shing zhal ngo mang zhig brgyud pa'i mthar kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' rdo rje/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa des bdag la'o/ / ci'agor 'jam dbyangs sprul pa ti pa tsa zhes yod pa'i gtad rul ga'u kha sbyor gyi brgyud pa ni/'di ratna gling pa'i gter ma yin tshul gsung rgyun du 'dug kyang gter gyi yong bab mi gcig pas the tshom gyi gzhin snang /sngags('chang tshe ring dbang po/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o//bdud/ btsan/ klu/ sa bdag rgyal po the brang rnams kyi gta' bsdam pa dang / stag pa/ shug pa/ skyer pa gsum gyi phur (237nasgo la brten nas btsa' bsrung ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang legs mchog pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter ston chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /slob dpon klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i char 'bebs mdzo ru ma'i lung phyag bzhes mnos pa'i brgyud pa gong ma rnams ma rnyed/ chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs/ snang gsal ba bkra shisargya mtsho/ rje du ma rang grol/ ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /—337—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nergyal bsrung nya mchu ma dang shing sna drug gis bsrung ba'i man ngag gi zur rtsa ba'i bla ma la zhus shing / desang ga dbang ye shes grub par gsan/ de yan ma rnyed/ bla ma gshong chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dag snang du byung ba'i tshe sgrub nam mkha' za ba/ cong zhi'i bcud len/ tshe bkra brtag pa gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ rig 'dzin kun bzang rnam rgyal/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gnubs kyis gshin rje nag po'i rgyud nas phyung ba'i phug ron gyi sgo nga dang rnga mo mgo gcig la brten nas ltasang na bzlog pa dang / mgo gsum la brten nas bzlog pa/ jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i rigs bsrung a li ma rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rje khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /(237ba)slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag dang jo mo la gnang ba'i byas pa bzhig pa'i man ngag 'go na oṃ dang mjug na swā hā med pa yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang legs mchog pa/zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rje khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rgya gar gyi dur khrod stso sha rar rdo rje phag mos thang stong rgyal po la gnang ba'i rims bsrung 'gor ha ri ṇi sa yod pa rdzas bzhi ma/ rdzas lnga la brten pa'i gnyan gzer gyi bsrung ba gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos bdag phag zhal can/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' legs pa/ mkhas grub shākya bshes gnyen/ pha rgod rgyal mtshan dpal/ rje btsun gzhong chen pa/ 'di yan si bas/ thugs sras bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rje khra tshang pa/ desabadag la'o/ /gnyis pa zab pa gter ma'i skor la/ thang yig tu gter ston phal cher gyi lung bstan mtshan smos rnams kyang las tsam las go rim des sbyar rung du mi 'dug pa dgos pa'i dbang gis gab dkrugs su mngon zhing / chos 'byung rnams su yang dpyad bzod mi bzod sna tsho gis snang la/ khri srong —338—

'chang yab yum gyi gtor ma gzhal yas khang du shes pas phyi nang gsang ba tshig gi dbang gtor ma brda don/ mchod rdzas/ dngos grub ste shes pa rnam pa bzhis byin rlabs lu gu rgyud legs par thob nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang ba'i gdams pa zhu lan gyi skor/ rdzo mo'i gdams skor man ngag tu bsdebs pa'i skor/ mnga' bdag rgyal po'i zhu lan gyi skor/ mnga' bdag dang jo mo thun mong gi zhu lan skor/ rje 'bangs rnams kyi zhu lan gyi skor/ rngog shes rab rgyal po'i zhu lan gyi skor dang drug las/ dang po jo mo'i zhu lan skor la/ gsang sngags gnad kyi man ngag ces bya ba bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa dang yi dam lha sgo me tshul/ skyabs 'grol ma khyer/ sems bskyed la mo khyer/ nyams ga shel 'phreng (246na)dri med/ gsang sngags kyi blo sbyong rin cen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba mtshan bcas lha sgom pa'i man ngag /bslab pa'i mtha' bcu la sbyong ba sogs kyi man ngag 'jug tu zhu lan bstan pa'i skor zhes bya ba/ dmar khrid skor gsum zhes pa zhe sdang can lha la brten nas 'khrid pa/ 'dod chags can thabs lam la brten nas 'khrid pa/ gti mug can mi rtog pa la brten nas 'khrid pa rnams/ gnyid lam khyer gyi gdams—349

mtshan/zur bde 258na 'gas rgyal mtshan phyi ma/zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na rgyal ba rin cen grub pa nas/sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/zur ngag dbang phun tshogs man 'dra/chung ba dpa' bo lha gsum skor dang a'i rtags yod pa ma gtogs lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/byams pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yan brtan/bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/rtsa ba'i bla ma khra tshang ba chen po/des bdag za hor bande la bde gshegs 'dusapa'i bsnyen sgrub zhal shes man ngag dang bcas te stsal to//bde gshegs / ltasang na brgya (khri)bzlog /mthar gtor ma gcig (sgyu rin khra tu dril ba'i lag len bskul dang bcas pa/ pho nya bskul zhing zor (khra)'phang ba'i 'phrong / gtor ma 'phang zhing bskul bya ba (khri)sgo dbye zor 'phen gyi 'phyong grags che ba/ yang gter byon 'khrul med zor la brten nas dgra bgegs gsad pa'i gzer gyi lag len gzer (khri)lnga la brten nas dgra bgegs gsad pa rnams/ drug pa las glegs bam chen por bcos pa dag la'ang kha zin thegs pa dka'o/ /de'i phyir bla ma'i man ngag snyan brgyud zab mo 'di'i skabs su dgos so zhes pa mchog gi sprul sku mnga' ris paṇa chen sogs mkhas grub rnams gsung ngo / /gsang ba nyams len gyi sgrub pa bka' brgyad bstan zin to/ /de ltar zab mo sngags kyi lto tshil zug pa lta bu'i bde gshegs 'dus pa 'di la/ spyi rgyud lnga ni sgrub sde bcu'i dril sgrub la gtso bor brtan pa'i rtsa ba yin te/ gong du bstan pa'i yan lag rgyud thams cad kyi sa bon yin no/ /de ltar rgyud bco lnga ni gsang sngags bla na med pa thams cad kyi skyed par byed pa'i sa bon lta bu yin pas rin cen gser gyi yi ge can zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi don 'grel par byed pa la gnyis su gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po lag na rdo rje'am rdo rje chos su grags pas mdzad 'dra/ yang gnyos mtshan ldan grub thob yan sngar ltar la/ de nas gnyos btsun pa/ gnyos seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rtsa bral ba chen po/ bya bral chos rje/ dge slong chen po yon to dpal/ dpal ldan don grub/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neb rig 'dzin snying po/ khra tshang pa wo po mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor gyi bande la'o/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi snying po dril ba'i dbang lung rnams legs par nos pa'i skor/sgos thems las/ de'i phyir thugs rje chen po yi rgyud lung man ngag kun 'dus pa 'gro ba 'dul (279bsgo'i sgrub thabs bzhugasaḥ zhes dang / gnad 'dus nor bu'i 'phreng ba las/ bdag 'dra o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyisaḥ bka' dang bstan bcos man ngag mtha' dag nas tshegs chung don che gnad du 'gro ba yi man ngag thams cad kha 'thor bcud bsdus nas brda dang gab tu ma bcug nor bu lugs rin cen 'phreng ba lta bur bkod pa 'di da lta'i dus na rje 'bangs rnams la gtadaḥ 'di nyid spel ba'i dus la ma babs pas phyi rabs don du rin cen gter du sped cesa'aphags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi snying po dril ba gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham zhing rgya che ba gzhan don dang zab pa rang don du nyams su blang bde ba thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bur grags pa bla ma mnga' bdag chen po nyang gis brag srin mo sbar rjes nas gdan drangs pa'i skor la/ dbang gi lag 'khrid chen mo'i steng nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dang po dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/ shel phreng /chos dbyug /ming dbang bcas pas thun mong dang rnam rgyal gyi khyad par te phyi bum pa'i dbang / gnyisapa nang gsang ba'i dbang / gsum pa de kho na nyid kyi dbang / bzhi pa lha dbang / lnga pa sngags dbang /drug pa chos dbang / bdun pa 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang / brgyad pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la dkar chag mthong ba don ldan/ de las byung ba dang —396

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ yob)thems med la/ rtsa ba (280na da kyi skor/ spros bcas sgrub chen skor/ spros med ku su lu'i skor/khog 'bubs zhal gdams skor/ nyams len dmar 'khrid skor/ zhi khro'i sgrub pa thor bu'i skor/bstan srung skor dang bdun/ dang po la/ thugs rje wo po 'gro 'dul rtsa ba'i rgyud la le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ de'i sa gcod chings kyi tshom zhes pa sa bcad/ de'i bshad 'grel rin cen sgron me/ thugs rje chen po rang byung ye shes kyi rgyud le'u so dgu pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs nges par ston pa rang byung ye shes phyi ma'i rgyud le'u so dgu pa/ lta ba yang thog gi rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ lta ba yang rtse'i rgyud le'u dgu pa/ don rgyud rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ thugs rje chen po'i thugasabargyud le'u bdun pa/ skor la/ thugs rje chen po rigs bsdus 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa lag tu blang ba'i lag 'khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang gi lag 'khrid rtsa ba dang lag len dngos slob dpon padma 'grang gnas kyis jo mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal dang lha sras khri srong lde btsan la brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du dbang bskur ba'i phyag bzhes yi ger bkod pa/dbang gi chu bo bzhi rdzogs rgyun dang lag len gnyis/ sman grub rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ gtor sgrub rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ bdun tshigs ro sbyong rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ gshin la phan gdags pa'i ro sgrub rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ ro sreg gi cho ga rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ gri 'dul gyi sbyong / rigs bsdus kyi las byang che ba dus bzhin gzhung bsrang ba/ bsdus pa gang zag blo dman 'jug pa bde ba/ tshogs mchod/ phyi mchod kyi rim pa rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ gtor ma cha bzhi rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis rnams/ gsum pa spros med ku su lu'i skor —397—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shel/ phyi drug skor/ nang bzhi skor/ gsang ba gsum skor/ de kho na nyid gcig skor/ yongs rdzogs phyag rgya rkyang pa dang lnga/ dang po phyi drug skor la/ brda skor sgrub skor gnyis las/ dang po la phyi po ta la'i ri'i brda chos drug wo gnyis/ nang thugs rje rpā po'i sku'i brda chos drug wo gnyis/ gsang ba yi ge drug pa'i brda/ chos drug wo gnyis te brda skor drug skor du gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub skor drug la sgrub thabs rtsa ba bsdus pa dang mngon rtogs rgyas pa gnyis spyir btang nas/ de'i bzlas rim la bdag don gyi bzlos par/ phyi thub pa drug sbyong du bzla ba la sgrub thabs dang mngon rtogs bzlas pa dngos dang gsum/ nang bde gshegs drug sbyong / gsang ba mkha' 'gro drug sbyong / yang gsang yi ge drug sbyong / de kho bskor ba/ dbang dus gcig la bya ba/ sbyin sreg dus gcig la bya ba/ sgrib pa dus gcig la sbyong ba/ khrus dus gcig la bya ba/ 'khor dong dus gcig la sprug pa/ sbyin gtor dus gcig la gtong ba/ chab gtor la gsum dang rang la bskul ma gdab pa la gsum ste drug /gzhan don gsum dang mos gus la gsum ste drug /gnas bsgyur la gsum dang gzhung gzung ba la gsum ste drug /don la blta ba la gsum dang 'gro don la gsum ste drug rnams bsdoms pa'o/ /drug pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyi gdams pa zhes bya ba yar lta ba la 'byams su mi gzhug pa'i chos drug /bar btang snyoms tha mal du mi gzhug pa'i chos drug /mar rgyu 'bras la zags su mi gzhug pa'i chos drug rnams dang / snga ma dang mi gcig pa'i khyad par —398

bstod kyi rim pa/ sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa/ rab gnas dang gsum/gson la phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ bzlas lung 'bogs pa/ dbang bskur/ sbyin sreg dang gsum/ gshin la phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ sbyin sreg /ro sbyong bum khrus dang gsum/ nad par phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ dgrag 'chos/ nad 'don/ bsrung 'khor gsum/ lus kyi chosaspyod gsum la/ phyag /skor ba/ spyod lam gsum/ ngag gi chos spyod gsum la/ gsol 'debs bstod pa bzlas pa gsum/ yid kyi chos gsum la bskyed rim rdzogs rim bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang gsum/ yang gsang khyad 'phags kyi chos la/ stong pa snying rje zung 'jug gsum/ khyad par gyi gdams pa gsum la/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ rdzogs pho gyi zab gnad rtsa dang rlung dang thig le sbyang (282ba)ba gsum/ 'da' ka ma'i zab khyad 'pho ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ bar do med par 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad bar do phyi nang gsang gsum/ bar do ngos 'dzin pa'i thabs gnyid dang 'od gsal rmi lam gsum/ phyi ltar sgyu lus/ nang ltar 'od gsal/ gsang ba ltar bsre ba'i man ngag dang gsum/ bskyed rdzogs la gces pa rlung sems bsre ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ rlung gnad kyi ting 'dzin zas su za zhing 'chi ba blu ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'i chos spyod gsum la/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/skom gyi rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gsum/ lhag ma gsum la zas lhag /sgom lhag /zan brdzis shul byin pa dang gsum/chu'i tshogs gsog gsum la/khrus/ sa la'i chu sbyin/ 'jur bgegs kyi chu sbyin dang gsum/ rten gyi tshogs gsog la/ maṇḍal sātstsha sku khrus gsum/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la/ 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor gsum/ 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor gsum/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gsum/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsum rnams/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid gcig skor la/sgrub thabs/ mngon she ) gas/ rgyun mchod/ gsol 'debs/ bstod pa/ rgyun bshags/ maṇḍal/ sems bskyed/ skyabs 'gro/ sgrib sbyong /skor ba/ sum sbyin sreg /zas skom/ gtor ma/ chu gtor/ zag pa dang lhag ma sbyin pa/ sku khrus/—400—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegasum rtsa ba bsdus pa dang lag len mngon rtogs/ rten 'brel gyi las kha tshar la brten nas tshogasagasog pa'i rim pa la/ mchod bstod kyi rim pa/ sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa/ rab gnas dang gsum/gson la phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ bzlas lung 'bogs pa/ dbang bskur/ sbyin sreg dang gsum/ gshin la phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ sbyin sreg /ro sbyong bum khrus dang gsum/ nad par phan 'dogs pa'i chos gsum la/ dbyug 'ong/ nad 'don/ bsrung 'khor gsum/ lus kyi chosaspyod gsum la/ phyag /skor ba/ spyod lam gsum/ ngag gi chos spyod gsum la/ gsol 'debs bstod pa bzlas pa gsum/ yid kyi chos gsum la bskyed rim rdzogs rim bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang gsum/ yang gsang khyad 'phags kyi chos la/ stong pa snying rje zung 'jug gsum/ khyad par gyi gdams pa gsum la/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ rdzogs pho gyi zab gnad rtsa dang rlung dang thig le sbyang (282ba)ba gsum/ 'da' ka ma'i zab khyad 'pho ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ bar do med par 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad bar do phyi nang gsang gsum/ bar do ngos 'dzin pa'i thabs gnyid dang 'od gsal rmi lam gsum/ phyi ltar sgyu lus/ nang ltar 'od gsal/ gsang ba ltar bsre ba'i man ngag dang gsum/ bskyed rdzogs la gces pa rlung sems bsre ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ rlung gnad kyi ting 'dzin zas su za zhing 'chi ba blu ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'i chos spyod gsum la/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/skom gyi rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gsum/ lhag ma gsum la zas lhag /sgom lhag /zan brdzis shul byin pa dang gsum/chu'i tshogs gsog gsum la/khrus/ sa la'i chu sbyin/ 'jur bgegs kyi chu sbyin dang gsum/ rten gyi tshogs gsog la/ maṇḍal sātstsha sku khrus gsum/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la/ 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor gsum/ 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor gsum/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gsum/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsum rnams/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid gcig skor la/sgrub thabs/ mngon she ) gas/ rgyun mchod/ gsol 'debs/ bstod pa/ rgyun bshags/ maṇḍal/ sems bskyed/ skyabs 'gro/ sgrib sbyong /skor ba/ sum sbyin sreg /zas skom/ gtor ma/ chu gtor/ zag pa dang lhag ma sbyin pa/ sku khrus/—400—

dam pa'i cho me kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ba)rin po che'i rgyun mchod/ snang ba tsho gos la ma/ bzlas lung blang ba/ dbyug bcos/ nad pa la byin rlabs/ nad 'don/ bsrung 'khor bsrung skud/ sri'u gsob/ sa bdag gdon 'grol/ spyo bog zhi ba/yams nad bsrung ba dang gso ba/ chu dang (283na shwa 'od ser bsrung / byad kha rbod ga sto bzlog pa/zas nor spel ba/ tshe dang bsod nams spel ba/ rigs brgyud sgrub pa/ dbang sdud/ tshar gcod/gnag rta lug gsum spel ba/ 'bru dang sris spel ba/ chos dang mi 'du thabs/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa/bcud len/ sa spyod sgrub pa/ mi rtog pa zas su za ba/ rlung zas su za ba/ byin rlabs zas su za ba/mtshan bcas sku la sems sbyangs te rim gyis 'tshang rgya thabs/ lta sgom spyod pa'i sgo nas cig char 'tshang rgya thabs/ tha mal pa rnams byang chub lam sna gzung ba rnams/ lnga pa phyag rgya rkyang pa'i skor la/sgrub thabs/ nyams len/ lta sgom gyi zhal gdams/ gsol 'debs/ yon tan brjod pa/ chos spyod maṇḍal/ byu sems bskyed/ skyabs 'gro/ lha phyag /zas sgom gyi rnal 'byor/ gtor ma/ chu gtor/ dbyug bcos/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugasaphyag rgya rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang slob dpon padma'i thugs bcud byung ba'i phyag rgya rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs rnams/ bzhi pa khog 'bubs zhal gdams skor la/ gong du bshad pa'i drug skor bzhi skor gsum skor tshig skor rnams kyi sa bcad kyi tshul du khog 'bubs pa lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal gdams nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ lnga pa nyams len dmar 'khrid skor la/ khyad par gyi dmar 'khrid rin cen 'phreng ba/ lam rim gnad 'dus rin cen 'od kyi phung po'am gnad 'dus nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ drug pa zhi khro'i sgrub pa thor bu'i skor la/ thugs rje chen po'i (283ba tha snyen sgrub sgrub pa chen po la brten nas bud med dbang du bsdu ba/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la brten nas 'jig rten dbang du bsdu ba/ yum la brten nas mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa rnams kyi zhi ba'i chos skor tshang ngo / /khro bo'i skor la rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs kyis rang byin gyis brlab pa'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba/ lag len mngon rtogs/ mtha' rten gdams —401—

ngo / /khro bo'i skor la rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs kyis rang byin gyis brlab pa'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba/ lag len mngon rtogs/ mtha' rten gdams —401—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('angag gi gnad brag phug zhwa ltar gyon pa/ 'dzab bsnyen chu bo'i gzhung ltar 'dren pa/ gtor tshogs ri ltar spungs pa gsum dang bcas pa'i shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ rta mgrin dregs pa tshar gcod kyi phur sgrub dbang mchog dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas pa/ thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i mdos skong rtsa ba dang lag len gnyis/ 'dir shag gi gtor ma yin kyang bla ma mnga' bdag chen por bka' babs pas 'di'i chosasder yod do/ /bdun pa bstan bsrung skor la/ thugs rje chen po'i bstan bsrung a pa ra tsitta'i nor bdag gsang rgyud le'u bcu pa/ a pa ra tsitta'i gsang rgyud phyi ma le'u lnga pa/ gnod sbyin snying sgrub/gnod sbyin gyi dngos grub sgrub thabs lag len bkod pa/ gnod sbyin rin po che dngos grub bzang po'i gsang sgrub rnams so/ /da dung gnod sbyin gyi skor la chos ka kha yar yong tshod du 'dug kyang kho bos nos pa ni bshad ma thag pa rnams yin la/ de dag gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsun/ mtshan ldan (284na sgong 'a bdag rin po che/ mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i mgon po/ mnga' bdag blo ldan/ mnga' bdag bdud 'dul/ mnga' bdag mdo sde seng ge /mnga' bdag padma dngosagrub/ mnga' bdag 'jam dpal nor bu/ mnga' bdag kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mnga' bdag nor bu'i mtshan can/ mnga' bdag kun dga' 'od zer/ mnga' bdag kun dga' 'phel/ mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub/ rig 'dzin lha bre ba ga rma gu sa rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' chos dbang / khra tshang pa chen po mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na sras mi bskyod rdo rje yan gong ltar la/ de nas zhabrul zhig mdo bo ras pa/ dbus pa brag gsum pa/ mnga' ris dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ grub chen dkon cog mgon po/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che padma dbang rgyal/ mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub man gong ltar ro/ /yang thugs rje chen po'i yum bka' mkha' 'gro gsang skor la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i lag 'khrid snyan brgyud rin cen sgron ma zhes pa le'u dang po gzhi snang tshul gnas lugs gtan la dbab —402

'khrid snyan brgyud rin cen sgron ma zhes pa le'u dang po gzhi snang tshul gnas lugs gtan la dbab —402

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las gleg bam gnyis pa/ yob)pa/ le'u gnyis pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ le'u gsum pa sngon du 'gro ba spyi 'gro gnad kyi gdams pa bstan pa/ le'u bzhi pa lam nyams su len pa'i thabs kyi rim pa bstan pa/le'u lnga pa 'bras bu zad sar skyel ba bstan pa/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs le'u bcu gcig pa/(284ba〉nasang ba ye shes kyi dbang smin lam rim pa dbang gi las zhes bya ba/ dkar mo sku'i bsnyen sgrub/ dmar mo gsung gi sgrub pa/ nag po thugs kyi sgrub pa dmar 'khrid rin cen 'phrong ba/ thabs lam padma bcud bsdus rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa yang gong ltar ro/ /mkha' 'gro gsang skor gyi chos bka' cha tshang ba la da dung re mang dgos yod 'dug kyang re zhig de tsam mo/ /padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i chos skor gyi dbang lung rjes gnang ji ltar nos tshul skor/bla ma mnga' bdag chen pos spyan drangs pa'i padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i chos skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas smin byed kyi dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ de'i skabs spyod don 'grel o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa/ sa bcad dpal seng pas mdzad pa/ o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang / sgrub pa tshe sbyin sreg rab gnas/ gnas lung gi byang bu/ slob dpon padma bzang po'i rnam thar/ rgyan 'god rgyal mtho dam sri sgo byang chag chag thig tshon mchod gtor sogs sngon 'gro'i skor/ sgrub pa'i tho yig mus srad pas mdzad pa/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi ngos 'dzin/ dbang chog bde chen myu gu/ lha dbang rdzas dbang gi yi ge /mus srad pas mdzad pa'i tshe dbang gi yi ge /tshe bkra brtag pa/ brgyud 'debs dngos grub gter mdzod/ dpa' gcig mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung ltar bris pa/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub —403—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun las gleg bam gnyis pa/ (ba)pa/ le'u gnyis pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ le'u gsum pa sngon du 'gro ba spyi 'gro gnad kyi gdams pa bstan pa/ le'u bzhi pa lam nyams su len pa'i thabs kyi rim pa bstan pa/le'u lnga pa 'bras bu zad sar skyel ba bstan pa/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs le'u bcu gcig pa/(284ba〉nasang ba ye shes kyi dbang smin lam rim pa dbang gi las zhes bya ba/ dkar mo sku'i bsnyen sgrub/ dmar mo gsung gi sgrub pa/ nag po thugs kyi sgrub pa dmar 'khrid rin cen 'phreng ba/ thabs lam padma bcud bsdus rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa yang gong ltar ro/ /mkha' 'gro gsang skor gyi chos bka' cha tshang ba la da dung re mang dgos yod 'dug kyang re zhig de tsam mo/ /padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i chos skor gyi dbang lung rjes gnang ji ltar nos tshul skor/bla ma mnga' bdag chen pos spyan drangs pa'i padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i chos skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas smin byed kyi dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ de'i skabs spyod don 'grel o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa/ sa bcad dpal seng pas mdzad pa/ o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang / sgrub pa tshe sbyin sreg rab gnas/ gnas lung gi byang bu/ slob dpon padma bzang pe'i rnam thar/ rgyan 'god rgyal mtho dam sri sgo byang chag chag thig tshon mchod gtor sogs sngon 'gro'i skor/ sgrub pa'i tho yig mus srad pas mdzad pa/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi ngos 'dzin/ dbang chog bde chen myu gu/ lha dbang rdzas dbang gi yi ge /mus srad pas mdzad pa'i tshe dbang gi yi ge /tshe bkra brtag pa/ brgyud 'debs dngos grub gter mdzod/ dpa' gcig mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung ltar bris pa/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub —403—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thabs o rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/de'i bsdus don/dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa/rtags bstod/khyung bstod/bkra shis 285na jibs bcad brgyad pa/sman rag gtor gsum byin rlob/byin 'bebs kyi dmigs pa/mus srad pas mdzad pa'i tshogs mtha' ma'i lag len/desamadzad pa'i spyi bskul gsum/des mdzad pa'i gser skyems rgyas bsdus/gnyen po yungs kar sgrol gying gi pho nya/gun dbab/lha dbye/khrag zor/sgo dbye/zor 'phang /dbang po rab 'bring tha gsumabartul zhugs dang bcas pa'i bro/sbyin sreg don bcu gcig ma/gnas byang gi ḍiska nyi ma'i 'od zer mus srad pa'i sgom khog rin cen 'phreng ba/sbas pa mig 'byed la las tshogs lnga bcu rtsa gsum/las phran la chu dang phye'i dka' thub/gtor ma'i las tshogs bcu bdun/bsrung ba/bsnyen tshad/gdon rtags/sngags chu/bsrung skud/chu bye mas bsrung ba/nad 'don/mnan pa/mig mthong /'khor lo kha sbyor gyis bgegs 'dul/rgyal 'gong dang bdud 'dul pa/gzir ba/mnan pa/byug pa/mdze brtag pa/chu srin gsad pa dang khong bur gzhug pa/sri'u gsob/gshen po 'drer mi yong ba/'dzul chog/lam bsrung /ser bsrung bka' rgya ma'i skor/thun zor/gtan ma'i las rim gyis ser ba dbab thabs bcu gnyis/sngags gsham 'dogs tshul dang gying lnga srog gcod kyi man ngag bee ro'i zhal khrigs/mchog sgrub la/lnga 'khrid sems gzung /lha brtag/gtum mo/rta skad thengs ga ṇi ga/bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug/dngos grub spyod pa/dug gsum lam slong /sdom pa dam tshig dngos grub yang dag lta brnams kyi shog dril/rdzogs rim 285bge shes gsang lam/padma gsang lam gyi nyams len gu rus chos rgyal la gsungs pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku padma dbang chen/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/lo wo rnam par snang mdzad/sgos pa lha'i me tog/gter ston nyi ma 'od zer/she ma 'od yang /grub thob 'dar phya ru ba rin cen bzang po/chos rgyal bo dong rin cen/kha ོ bsod nams brtan pa/mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang /kun mkhyen ༷༷la ldan seng ge/chos rje bsod nams bzang po/

chen mo zer ba yod cing / gzhung 'di'i nang tshan sa bcad la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum du byas pa'i thog mar sngon 'gro'i skabs smin grol gyi dbang dang gdams ngag zhu ba/ sgrub pa'i gnas btsal nag po gcod shog gi mtha' can/ sngags rgod nag po drang srong gi dmod pa rnal 'byor pa'i mtshon cha bram ze log tri'i man ngag la lha bsgom zhing lus bdud chas su bya ba/ bskyed rim/ bzlas pa/ bka' bsgo/ smyo 'bog 'dul ba/mdze gso ba/ rbod gtong bzlog pa/ bar gcod 'dul ba/ dgra bsad pa/ me 'khor/ chu 'khor/ rlung 'khor/ sa 'khor/ bsrung ba/ bzlog pa/ bsad pa/ byug pa/ spyod lam/ gtor ma/ spogs rgyal po sum brgya drug cu ma/ sa gnad/ btsan gyi 'gyur ldog zhang se ba la brten pa'i rang bsrung rjesagacod rwa ru la brten pa'i zhal shes/ gsa'i snying khrag la brten pa'i zhal shes/ btsan khams bzlog pa shāka thub sku'i 'khor lo/gnod sbyin gyi gdon tshogs bzlog pa tshe dpag med gsung gi 'khor lo/ klu gdon bzlog pa phyag rdor thugs kyi 'khor lo/ gza' gdon bzlog pa rnam 'joms yon to gyi 'bor lo/ ma mo'i gdon —438

gyi brag la mchisaḥ thugs gter lnga las khyad 'phags 'di kho na ci phyir nga yi snying nor mig 'bras yin mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongasaḥ zhes dang / gzhan yang ji skad du/ thugs gter gcig ni lho brag gnam skas can la spedaḥkhyad par bla ma'i sgrub skor yinaḥ mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pas 'don par 'gyuraḥ zhes mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i gsung gi gsal 'gag pa med pa/ rig pa spyi blug gis chos sku gcer mthong du ston pa'i smin byed dbang dang / 'khrid chen brgyad kha skong zhal shes dang bcas pa'i sgo nas theg pa gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i yid ches skyed pa'i lo rgyus dang gzhud gi bzhugs tshul gyi khog phub nas grol rkyen grol lam du 'gyur ba'i stong thun sngon du btang ste thun mong sngon 'gro skyabs sems/tshogs gsag /rang byin brlab/ gsol 'debs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pas ye shes kyi sgo phye nas dngos gzhi sems ma bcos sor 'jog dang rtsal spyong gis bogs dbyung ste don 'khrid kyis ka dag gi rig pa gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa'i nyams 'khrid legs par nos nas/ lung la snying dang 'dra ba thugs gter gyi skor/ snying khrag dang 'dra ba yang gter gyi skor/ dwangs ma dang 'dra ba thems med kyi skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyud 'grel las logs su med pa'i phyir de dag gi bcud rnams yang gter thems med gnyis su tshang bar byas te ma spros/ gnyis pa snying khrag dang 'dra ba yang gter gyi skor la/ spyi'i chings stong thun gyi skor/ btagasagrol rgyud kyi skor/ don 'grel 'khrid gzhung skor/ bltas grol man ngag gi skor/ kha skong lung gi skor dang lnga/ dang po la/ ba'i yid ches skyed pa'i lo rgyus dang gzhud gi bzhugs tshul gyi khog phub nas grol rkyen grol lam du 'gyur ba'i stong thun sngon du btang ste thun mong sngon 'gro skyabs sems/tshogs gsag /rang byin brlab/ gsol 'debs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pas ye shes kyi sgo phye nas dngos gzhi sems ma bcos sor 'jog dang rtsal spyong gis bogs dbyung ste don 'khrid kyis ka dag gi rig pa gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa'i nyams 'khrid legs par nos nas/ lung la snying dang 'dra ba thugs gter gyi skor/ snying khrag dang 'dra ba yang gter gyi skor/ dwangs ma dang 'dra ba thems med kyi skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyud 'grel las logs su med pa'i phyir de dag gi bcud rnams yang gter thems med gnyis su tshang bar byas te ma spros/ gnyis pa snying khrag dang 'khrid chen brgyad kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ chos kyi dbang po yan gong ltar la/ legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can/ thugs srasang ga gi dbang po/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang gong du khra'i rtags med pa rnams kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la la rma gu ru nas/ bya btang chos dbang bsam grub/ mnyam med chos dbang kun bzang / rig 'dzin ga me gsang sngags/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang mnal lam zhwa nag mar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi cha lag tu gtogs pa 'dir zhal gdams khyad par can gcig byung ba bka' rgyas btab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mnal lam bka' rgya ma'am thugs gter sgo 'byed kyi lde mig snyan brgyud chen mor grags pa mchan dang bcas pa/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i yab rin po che skal ldan pas chos dbang la zhus pa nyang zhus nges don bgegs sel zhes pa nyang rdo rje mgon pos dkar chag tu phab pa/ nyang dbon rin po che'i gsung mdo rgyud ma/nyang sman lung skal ldan pa mya ngan las 'da' khar zhu 'phrin du mdzad pa snying gtam gces pa'i nor bu/de'i lan chos dbang rin po ches mdzad pa mnyam sbyor bsdus don kun gyi dngos gzhi la/ de'i bsdus don sras padma dbang chen gyis mdzad pa/ chos dbang gi dus mtha' ma'i zhal chems le'u gsum (316na)pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi brgyud 'debs skye med spros bral ma rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug /thugs sras mtshan ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ drin can ma/ gu ru chos kyi rdo rje/sprul sku nor bu 'dzin pa/ cho ge rje nor bu don grub/ sangs rgyas nor bzang / gos gto chos rgyal/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rig 'dzin kurma gu sa rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / yang na rkarma gu ru la kun mkhyen dbang phyug /de gnyis ka la mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang rdzogs pa rṣa po ci khi skor la/ lo rgyus don gyi sgron ma yon to rin po che'i rgya can/khog 'bub stong thun sgron ma sku 'khor lo'i rgya can/ bshad thabs gsal ba'i sgron ma gsung padma'i rgya —446

la'o/ /yang gong du khra'i rtags med pa rnams kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la la rma gu ru nas/ bya btang chos dbang bsam grub/ mnyam med chos dbang kun bzang / rig 'dzin ga me gsang sngags/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang mnal lam zhwa nag mar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi cha lag tu gtogs pa 'dir zhal gdams khyad par can gcig byung ba bka' rgyas btab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mnal lam bka' rgya ma'am thugs gter sgo 'byed kyi lde mig snyan brgyud chen mor grags pa mchan dang bcas pa/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i yab rin po che skal ldan pas chos dbang la zhus pa nyang zhus nges don bgegs sel zhes pa nyang rdo rje mgon pos dkar chag tu phab pa/ nyang dbon rin po che'i gsung mdo rgyud ma/nyang sman lung skal ldan pa mya ngan las 'da' khar zhu 'phrin du mdzad pa snying gtam gces pa'i nor bu/de'i lan chos dbang rin po ches mdzad pa mnyam sbyor bsdus don kun gyi dngos gzhi la/ de'i bsdus don sras padma dbang chen gyis mdzad pa/ chos dbang gi dus mtha' mtshan/ drin can ma/ gu ru chos kyi rdo rje/sprul sku nor bu 'dzin pa/ chos rje nor bu don grub/ sangs rgyas nor bzang / gos gto chos rgyal/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rig 'dzin kurma gu sa rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / yang na rkarma gu ru la kun mkhyen dbang phyug /de gnyis ka la mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang rdzogs pa rṣa po ci khi skor la/ lo rgyus don gyi sgron ma yon to rin po che'i rgya can/khog 'bub stong thun sgron ma sku 'khor lo'i rgya can/ bshad thabs gsal ba'i sgron ma gsung padma'i rgya —446

brlab pa dang bcas pa rnams las bu ston gong khug ma ma gags pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni khra tshang pa bzhugs pa'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi brgyud pa ltar dang / bu (325na ston gong khug ma'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas bla ma tshul khrims bzang po/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen mchog grub/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ khra tshang pa wo po/ des bdag la'o/ /kha bsgyur nyer gcig ma gtogosapa'i zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni bla ma gsang 'dus dang 'dra/ kha bsgyur nyer gcig gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la sprul sku chos kyi dbang po nas/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ ba le ba rnam rgyal dpal bzang / rtag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ zur chen gzhon nu don grub/ de srasachos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skor ni/ rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs sgrub wo rtsa ba dang ཿ sgrub 'bum dbang 'bum mngon rtogs las byang dang ཿ thun mong spyi gdams bstod bskul tshogs las dang ཿ stod smad las kyi mde kha nyi shu gcig bstan srungs pho lha'i skor sogs yig sna ni: bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dag gis yongs su rdzogs: zhes gsungs pas/ shes—459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nerab/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ gtong ba/ las 'phro re re la gsum gsum du phye ba'i dge ba'i chos bco lnga ldan pa'i snod ldan la gdams dbang bkra shis smon lam gdab pa sogs brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ma nyams par nos nas/ lung gi skor la/ dbang sgrub 'phrin las skor/ las sde'i skor/ bka' srungs skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i sgrub thabs spyi bye brag kun gsang ba yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba'i sdom mtsho rgyal gyis lan bcu gsum zhus pa'i rting la gnang ba/ sgrub chen yongs rdzogs kyi tha rams su grags pa rtsa tho'am sdom gyi sa bcad rgyal yum mtsho rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub chen gyi sngon 'gro sta gon bsnyen sgrub gzhung srong logs su bkol ba/ dngos gzhi bsnyen blang ba/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhu lan rin po che'i 'od cesabya ba dbang gi spar khab slob dpon gyis rdzo mo la gsungs pa/ sgrub chen gyi rgyab skyor zhal gdamasanyams len rgyun khyer/ nyams len rgyun khyer chog sgrigs ma/ gsang sngags nyams su pa'i spra 'khrid sgrub chen gsang ba yongs rdzogs la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi spyi khog lag len gsal ba'i sgron me nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba sgrub chos drug gsum bco brgyad/ sgrub 'bum chog sgrigs (326na)rgyal sras sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i phyag bzhes dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ dbang bskur rtsa ba/ dbang 'bum chog sgrigs mdzad byang mi gsal yang lag len shin tu bde ba mchog thun dngos grub sgrub thabs sman lung pas mdzad dam zer ba rnams/ gnyis pa las lde'i skor la/ gzhal yas don bstod —460

kyi (346na tha sdus don gsal bar byed pa'i mig ces bya ba/ des mdzad pa'i rgyud don rnam par bshad pa rin po che gter gyi rgyan zhesabya ba rnams so/ /de yang rdo rje'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la brten nas sgrub chen gyi khongs su chos sde thams cad kyi don yongs su rdzogs pa slob ma'i rgyud la 'char ba zhig dgos zhes mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che gsung ba ni khri srong lde btsan slar yang bsams bzhin du byon pa'i dad pa'i gsos so/ /de ltar chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa la dbang dang rgyud sde'i bka' babs tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni ye ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum gyis rgyal ba rigs lnga la ye shes lnga'i rtsal dbang bskur bas longs spyod rdzogs skur shar/ rigs lngas dam pa tog dkar la dbang bskur ba la brten nas des phyi shākya thub par sprul nas lag na rdo rje 'chang la dbang bskur/nang rdo rje 'chang du sprul nas rdo rje chos la dbang bskur/ gsang ba rdo rje sems dpar sprul nas gsang ba'i bdag po la dbang bskur/ de nas dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhir gyes pa las/ gsang bdag gi po ti glegs bam gyi dbang ind+ra bhū ti la/ des o rgyan chen po la/ rdo rje sems dpas yi dam lha'i dbang dga' rab rdo rje dang shrī sidha gnyis la/ de gnyis kyis o rgyan chen po la/ sras mo go ma de nyis o rgyan nyid la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang bskur zhing bi ma las kyang bskur bas byin rlabs kyis rdo rje 'chang dang mjal te mkhas pa paṇḍita'i dbang thob/ rig pa rang rtsal gyi dbang ni o rgyan nyid kyi rang byung du thob (346bsgo yin pas dbang gi chu bo drug go /sgrub sde so so'i dbang ni he ru ka brgyad kyi ngo bo rig 'dzin brgyad kyis dpal o rgyan chen po la gnang ngo / /gnyis pa rgyud sde'i babs tshul ni rgyal ba rigs lngas rdo rje chos la gsungs/ des ri ma la ya'i rtse mor gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe lha grags ldan mchog skyong / gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po blo gros thabs ldan/klu rgyal 'jog po/ li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa ste dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la gnang bas/—489

slar yang bsams bzhin du byon pa'i dad pa'i gsos so/ /de ltar chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa la dbang dang rgyud sde'i bka' babs tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni ye ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum gyis rgyal ba rigs lnga la ye shes lnga'i rtsal dbang bskur bas longs spyod rdzogs skur shar/ rigs lngas dam pa tog dkar la dbang bskur ba la brten nas des phyi shākya thub par sprul nas lag na rdo rje 'chang la dbang bskur/nang rdo rje 'amang du sprul nas rdo rje chos la dbang bskur/ gsang ba rdo rje sems dpar sprul nas gsang ba'i bdag po la dbang bskur/ de nas dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhir gyes pa las/ gsang bdag gi po ti glegs bam gyi dbang ind+ra bhū ti la/ des o rgyan chen po la/ rdo rje sems dpas yi dam lha'i dbang dga' rab rdo rje dang shrī sidha gnyis la/ de gnyis kyis o rgyan chen po la/ sras mo go ma de nyis o rgyan nyid la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang bskur zhing bi ma las kyang bskur bas byin rlabs kyis rdo rje 'chang dang mjal te mkhas pa paṇḍita'i dbang thob/ rig pa rang rtsal gyi dbang ni o rgyan nyid kyi rang byung du thob (346bsgo yin pas dbang gi chu bo drug go /sgrub sde so so'i dbang ni he ru ka brgyad kyi ngo bo rig 'dzin brgyad kyis dpal o rgyan chen po la gnang ngo / /gnyis pa rgyud sde'i babs tshul ni rgyal ba rigs lngas rdo rje chos la gsungs/ des ri ma la ya'i rtse mor gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe lha grags ldan mchog skyong / gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po blo gros thabs ldan/klu rgyal 'jog po/ li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa ste dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la gnang bas/—489

phye ste kun gyi bka' o rgyan chen po nyid la babs so/ /de nas dpal o rgyan chen pos rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / khyad par du rje khri srong lde btsan/ 'bangs nam mkha'i snying po/ gzungs ma gter ston gyi bde 'dus kyi dbang mnga' bdag 'gro mgon la gsan pa'i don brgyud kyi dbang du byas nas gter ston gyi sngon du 'gro mgon mnga' bdag yab sras gnyis brgyud gral du 'jug srol yod/ de nas sras chos rje skal ldan pa yab sras la gnang bas sras yar klungs sprul sku mi bskyod rdo rjes yar klungs sman lung dgon par grub pa brnyes/ des dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje la gnang bas tsa ri'i gnas sgo dpal 'byor dbang phyug la gnang bas dwags po spa lung bsam gtan gling du grub pa brnyes/ des chos dbang gdung rabs brgyad pa sprul sku chos kyi —490—

pa lugs gcig la gter ston yan gong ltar la/ de nas rgyal sras padma dbang chen/ rig 'dzin shākya 'bum/ rig 'dzin shākya seng ge /rig 'dzin byang chub rdo rje/ rig 'dzin sangs rgyas rin cen/ rig 'dzin ltar la/ de nas phag ston shākya mgon po/ spug ston dpal ldan mgon po/ sngagasal4 rdor rgyan mgon po/ spyi zur phug pa sngags 'chang mchog grub rdo rje/ grub mchog chos rgyal bsod nams ma na gong ltar rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebargyud 'dzin legs pa dpal bzang / mkhas btsun cho me 'phags bzang po/ lha rigs 'jam dbyangasargyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /yang na brgyud 'dzin legs pa dpal bzang nas/ sprul sku nyang ston chos dbang / gnubs chen rin cen dpal bzang / gnubs chen rgyal sras padma/ mkhas grub tshul khrims dpal bzang / de gnyis ka la mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis gsan pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na lha bro ba sprul sku chos kyi dbang po yan gong ltar la/ de nas lha btsun legs ldan rdo rje man sngar bzhin/ yang sras padma dbang chen nas/ grub chen dmar zhabs ras pa/ 'gro mgon bkra shis mtshan can/ chos rgyal grags pa blo gros/ bdud 'dul shes rab 'od wo/ rnam mkhyen chos kyi blo gros/ grub thob tshul khrims dpal/ bya bral bsod nams seng ge /rje 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ dam pa chos skyong tshul khrims/ de gnyis ka la lha rigs 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang mkhas btsun tshul khrims dpal bzang gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis ka la lha rigs paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal gyis gsan pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung rgyun lugs gcig la/ khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje nas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kyi gdung brgyud lha bro ba chos kyi dbang po rkarma gu sa karma dbang 'byor gsum ma gtogs gzhan mtha' dag slob ma kho na yin pas slob brgyud do/ /mgyogs dbang bum pa'i rgya can gyi dbang dang yo ga gsum gyi sgom khog gi lung rgyun tsam la rgyal sras padma dbang chen nas/ gu ru mtshan ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sras mo sangs rgyas kun grol/ gu ru cha kyi rdo rje/ gu ru nor bu 'dzin pa/ gu ru nor bu don grub/ gu ru sangs rgyas nor bzang /gu ru bshes gnyen chos rgyal/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang po nas/ khra tshang pa chen po'i bar gong ltar ro/ /deng sang chos kyi rtsa khungs kyi brgyud pa bla ma so so'i gsan yig rnam thar lo rgyus sogs gang yang ma thos shing slob brgyud las gdung brgyud gtso che khul gyi dbang lung man ngag thams cad kyi brgyud par —492

he ru ga'i sku gsung thugs su 'dus par bstan pa'i sdoms chung /he ru spu'i yang dag snying po don gyi 'phrin las rnams/gnyis pa yan lag la/bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i dbang du byas nas chos thams cad brda'i sgo nas mtshon par bya ba'i phyir khro bo thams cad kyi rtsa ba dpal he ru ka dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgom rim/sgrub pa sde brgyad lung a nu yo ga ltar nyams su blang thabs/sgrub pa sde brgyad man ngag a ti yo ga ltar nyams su blang thabs/'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi thugs gdeng gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags zla gsang khri drug stong gi don bcud phyung ba nā ga rdzuna'i thugs gdeng dbang chen 'dus pa'i drag sngags rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kun gyi don bcud phyung ba/hūṃ ka ra'i thugs gdeng khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i drag sngags yang dag thugs rgyud kun gyi don bcud phyung ba/bi mā la'i thugs gdeng che mchog 'dus pa'i drag sngags bdud rtsi rol pa'i rgyud kun gyi don bcud phyung ba/pra bha ha sti'i thugs gdeng phur pa 'dus pa'i drag sngags bi drotta ma la 'bum sde'i don bcud phyung ba/dha na saṃ : 'i thugs gdeng ma mo 'dus pa'i drag sngags srid pa bem rgyud kun 352bgyi don bcud phyung ba/rom bu gu rgya'i thugs gdeng sde brgyad 'dus pa'i drag sngags dregs rgyud thams cad kyi don bcud phyung ba/shanti ga lha'i thugs gdeng dmod pa 'dus pa'i drag sngags drag sngags tan tra kun gyi bcud phyung ba/che mchog bka' srung ce spyang ma brgyad sgrub pa/'jam dpal bka' srung gri thogs ging /khram thogs bdud/sho thogs rtsis/srog gcod bshan pa rnams kyi sgrub pa/dbang chen bka' srung khyi sbyang 'brug mo dmus long rnams kyi sgrub pa/khrag 'thung bka' srung srin mo nyer brgyad sgrub pa/phur pa'i bka' srung dregs pa bcu gnyis kyi sgrub pa/bar 'dar ma mo'i bas srung mi bog pa shog ser med dmo dpyad/mchod bstod dang dmod pa'i bka' srung sde brgyad drag sngags brgyad la/gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags/ma mo 'dus pa'i drag sngags/gdug pa klu'i drag sngags/drag rtsal lha'i drag sngags/hur thum gza'i drag sngags/// rdo gnod sbyin gyi drag sngags/khro gtum srin po'i

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig ga rnyi chu rgyun las gleg bam gnyi pa/ (kha)drag sngags/'phung bshig bdud kyi drag sngags/bka' brgyad tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs la ma hā yo ga'i sgo nas bstod pa bcom ldan dmag dpung bshig ste ye shes rang byung du 'char zhing nges shes bskyed pa/rjes kyi man ngag dgus gegs sel bogs dbyung ste chos sku ka dag gcer mthong ngo sprod pa'i gdams pa gsang bcud kyi dmar khrid 'gro'i skor la/rtsa ba blo'i spros pa yod ༷༷sa bdun/chos spyod bcu gnyis/zhu lan drug pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung tsom/ ()phur pa/mtha' rten ga 'a dbang dang bcas pa legs par nos nas/lung la/lo rgyus/lha bsgom pa/sngags kyi bsrung ba bsnyen sgrub/'phrin las/bsrung 'khor/bum chog rdzas kyi byug bdug rgyal bsen srog 'khor/4 'bebs/ser bsrung /phan pa/sbyin sreg khu'i rdzi 'du pob/gtor dbagarta nag gi las byang rin po tsho phreng ba/gter kha gong 'og gnyis ka'i rta nag gi dbang chog byin rlabs me chen zhes bya ba khyab bdag khra tshang pas mdzad pa rnams las dbang go brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku rta mchog nag po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/mnga' bdag khri srong lde bsko/ga kho ston gu ru chos dbang /yar klungs sprul sku mgo lnga'i nang 'a shāka 'od dang chos ldan pa gnyis la gnang /de gnyis gas sman lung pa shāka 'bum dang shāka gas gnyis la gnang/de ga rdzis kyis rje spon 365bcu me kyi 'od zer/rgya ra klong wo pa sna gos rang grol/slob dpon rin cen bzang po/a dkar ba rin cen dbang phyug/ri khrod pa nam mkha' dpal/ga dze grags pa rgyal mtshan/btsun pa mtsho skyes rdo rje/spang ban rkarma gu sa brag sna ba kun ma' dbang phyug/khyab bdag blo ma rdzo rdo rje/des bdag za hor bande la'o//lung gi brgyud pa ni/ga mi khu ru yan gong ltar la/de nas thugs sras karma dbang 'byor/khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//chos dbang rin po ches gnam skas brag nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi themasamed la gtogs pa gu ru seng ge sgra sgrogs gam phyag na rdo rje gtum po me lce'i 'phreng bar grags pa ni/bka' rtsis las/rdo rje gtum po klu gnyan sa bdag gshed ces gsungs pa ltar 'di'i sgo nas srasamos mdze rgyun bcad pas drin can mar grags pa yang 'di la brten nas byung bas mchog tu zab pa'i chos skor la/thog mar bum thod rdo rje ga sto ma cod pan gyis sku gsung thugs yon to tshon lasakyi dbang dang bzlas lung sogs shog ser gyi dri ma kha chil li ba thob nas/lung la/bsnyen pa/sgrub sngags/las sbyor la ser 'bebs/rig sngags sgroX pa/seng phur la brten pa'i ser bsrung /tsi tsi
