dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gci chu rgyun la glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ba) wa gyi mgul pa 'dra ba'i ngos nas spyan drangs pa'i dzam dkar la brten nas dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir du nor sgrub rin cen spungs pa dzam dkar gsang ba ltar rdza'i ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa/nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa/ 'khor (367bang ka' sdod du sgrub pa/ phyag mtshan ne'u le'i sgrub pa shin tu gsang ba myur mgyogs/ bstod pa nor bdag chen po slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ dzam la gtso 'khor dgu'i bstod pa tshig rkang bco lnga pa dgos 'dod re stong sman lung mi bskyod rdo rjes nga la zhal gzigs ltar mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa gong bzhin no//yang bka' rtsis las/ gu lang gsang sgrub mi nor dbang du byed ces gsungs pa'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs sku dang glang dmar la brten pa/ lan dur du sgrub pa/ dngos grub blang ba rnams dang gong gi dzam dkar gyi brgyud lugs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos longs sprul gsum/ gter ston/ sman lung pa/ dwags ston/ gnyen ston pa/ se sdings pa yab sras/ chos 'od/ dpal 'byor dbang phyug /chos kyi dbang po/ gan gu sa kun mkhyen dbang phyug khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gis klu bdud lto ba nas gdan drangs pa'i 'joms byed 'char ka 'chi bdag nag po'i skor/ bka' rtsis las/ a tsa ra nag po cog brdung sde drug ni gza' yi cog brdung spu gri gsang rgal dang : ma mo'i cog brdung bong zhen nag mo dang ཿ mgon po'i cog brdung beng chen ma tang da zlog pa'i cog brdung 'char ka nag po dang : ltasang na cog brdung byang sman rgyal po dang : ser ba'i cog brdung dbang phyug gu lang ngo : cog brdung sde drug bstan srung rkang yin pas dam ldan snying rus (368na lon gyi mtshon cha yin zhes gsungs pa'i nang tshan zlog pa'i cog brdung gi skor la/ thog mar gdong zor spu gri 'bar ba'i zor dbang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i steng nas dbang tshar gcig dang / dbang chog gong ma dang cung zad 'dra min yod pa zor dbang thun mong ma yin pa kun la med pa'i zab chos su grags pa'i steng nas zor dbang tshar gcig rnams —519

cen spungs pa dzam dkar gsang ba ltar rdza'i ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa/nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa/ 'khor (367bang ka' sdod du sgrub pa/ phyag mtshan ne'u le'i sgrub pa shin tu gsang ba myur mgyogs/ bstod pa nor bdag chen po slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ dzam la gtso 'khor dgu'i bstod pa tshig rkang bco lnga pa dgos 'dod re stong sman lung mi bskyod rdo rjes nga la zhal gzigs ltar mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa gong bzhin no//yang bka' rtsis las/ gu lang gsang sgrub mi nor dbang du byed ces gsungs pa'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs sku dang glang dmar la brten pa/ lan dur du sgrub pa/ dngos grub blang ba rnams dang gong gi dzam dkar gyi brgyud lugs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos longs sprul gsum/ gter ston/ sman lung pa/ dwags ston/ gnyen ston pa/ se sdings pa yab sras/ chos 'od/ dpal 'byor dbang phyug /chos kyi dbang po/ ga rma gu sa kun mkhyen dbang phyug khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gis klu bdud lto ba nas gdan drangs pa'i 'joms byed 'char ka 'chi bdag nag po'i skor/ bka' rtsis las/ a tsa ra nag po cog brdung sde drug ni gza' yi cog brdung spu gri gsang rgal dang : ma mo'i cog brdung bong zhen nag mo dang ཿ mgon po'i cog brdung beng chen ma tang da zlog pa'i cog brdung 'char ka nag po dang : ltasang na cog brdung byang sman rgyal po dang : ser ba'i cog brdung dbang phyug gu lang ngo : cog brdung sde drug bstan srung rkang yin pas dam ldan snying rus (368na lon gyi mtshon cha yin zhes gsungs pa'i nang tshan zlog pa'i cog brdung gi skor la/ thog mar gdong zor spu gri 'bar ba'i zor dbang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i steng nas dbang tshar gcig dang / dbang chog gong ma dang cung zad 'dra min yod pa zor dbang thun mong ma yin pa kun la med pa'i zab chos su grags pa'i steng nas zor dbang tshar gcig rnams —519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nelegs par nos/ lung la/ rtsa bar gyur pa rgyud/ de las byung ba sngags sgrub/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gshin rje 'char ka nag po'i rtsa ba gsang ba'i rgyud chen mo le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i sngags sgrub la/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ sngon 'gro/ gnas/ dkyil 'khor/ bsten rdzas/ 'phrin las kyi rim pa rnams kyis don drug tu bstan pa/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ sngags/ lha'i gnad/ dam tshig dang gsum gyisabastan/ gsum pa las sbyor la/ bsrung bzlog gsad mnan bzhi las/ gsang ba srin sbar mar dkyus su 'byung yang 'dir gud du sbas pa'i dngos bstan bsrung bzlog mnan pa dang gsum las/dang po bsrung ba la spyi bye brag gnyis/ dang po spyir bsrung ba la/ mdos/ 'khor lo/ gtor ma/ ting 'dzin/ sngags/ zor/ sbyin sreg gi bsrung ba dang bdun/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bsrung ba la/ nad pa/sgrig ser ba/ rims/ rta phyugs/ mdze 'phro/ zho chang bsrung ba dang bdun/ gnyis pa bzlog pa la spyi bye brag (36yiganyis/ dang po spyir bzlog pa la/ mdos/ 'khor lo/ gtor ma/ ting 'dzin/ sngags/zor/ sbyin sreg gis bzlog pa dang bdun/ gnyis pa bye brag tu bzlog pa la/ ltasang na/ 'chi ba/phur kha/ dmag dpung / mi kha rmi lam/ nad yams/ byol chags bzlog pa dang bdun/ gsad pa'i sa bcad dang mdos kyis gsang ba zur tsam bstan nas/ bzhi pa mnan pa la spyi phyug/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po man gong bzhi no//ga kho ston chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab ga kho bod skyong bstan ma ༄ gnyis kyi skor la/srog dbang gsar ma'i rjes gnang gi rigs la gzhogs drud pa'i blos byas rnams dang mi 'dra bar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes nyams pa med par yid ches khungs btsun pa'i phyag srol ltar nos nas/lung la/phyi mas ma rdzas kyi bla rdo/nang rtsa rma thig le'i bla rdo/377na gsang ba bde rpā dbyings kyi bla rdo'i man ngag khyad par can rig 'dzin padma dbang rgyal rdo rjes mdzad pa/bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mngon rtogs lcags rdo pa phur pa'i ming can gyi brjed byang /bstan ma'i bkang gso dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba dbu na nag mo bzhin mi sdug pa'i bu mo sogs yod pa/gsol mchod dpal gyi sprul pa ma/'phrin las gnyer gto dpal gyi thugs sprul ma/nges don la sbyar ba'i mchod pa 'phrin bcol dpal chen khrag 'thung pa/bstan ma bcu gnyis la pha rabs kyi tshul du bstod pa/mkha' 'gro bstan ma'i srog gi bka'i rjes gnang bstan ma las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las byung ste paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal gyis bu tshal pho brang du mdzad pa/bstan ma'i rjes gnang gi phyag len shin tu gces pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/bod kyi yul bdag wo mo'i dbang chog 6ter)nag po 'gro shes su rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bsgrigs pa'i dngos grub char 'bebs rnams thob pa las gter gyi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/khrag 'thung he ru ka/o rgyan sangasargyas gnyis pa/ga kho ston chos kyi dbang phyug/sras padma dbang rsā/dmar zhabs ras wo/chosargyal grags pa rgyal mtshan/'gro mgon bkra shis mtshan can/'dud 'dul shes rab 'od chen/rnam dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gci chu rgyun la gleg bam gnyis pa/ (ba)gter kha 'og ma'i kha 'bar ma dkar mo la brten nas 'chi ba blu ba/ kha 'bar ma nag mo la ltas ngan sri byad kha sogs bar gcod bzlog pa/ kha 'bar ma khra bo la brten nas dgra bo kha smasabazlog pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang po yan rdo rje pha lam ltar la/ de nas rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i phyag len byang bdag pos mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/byang bdag yan gong ltar la/ rig 'dzin ngag (380bka dbang po/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /mon tsa spros gu ru rin po che la zhus nas gnam skas brag tu sbas pa chos dbang rin po ches spyan drangs pa'i sems bskyed bstan pa'i snying po'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/thugs rje chen po/ o rgyan yab yum/ chos dbang rin po che/ sman lung shāka 'od/ dwags ston pa/ gnyan ston pa/ rtse sdings pa khu dbon gnyis/ gu ru chos 'od/ 4chas med dar ma bzang po/ zhabs drung chos dbang dpal 'byor/ rje nam mkha' shes rab/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /lho brag mkho mthing lha khang gi rnam snang gi nu mchin g.yas pa nas chos dbang rin po ches gdan drangs pa'i bstan pa'i gzhi ma gtsug lag khang gso thabs la nang gses su/ 'byung ba'i stobs nyams pas mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams 'jig tshul/ bdud kyi nus pas semasacan rnams sdug bsngal ba/ gtsug lag khang phyi bsod nams kyi rten dang gos kyi rten 'brel/ nang zas kyi rten 'brel/ gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo la brten nas gso ba/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum spangs te sgrub pa la/ phyi gsung rab 'dri klog /nang dbyangs gsal/ gsang ba 'khor lo la brten nas tshe 'phel ba/ ngag gi mi dge bzhi spangs nas phyi mchod rten bzhengs pa/ nang rdo rje/ gsang ba me long la brten nas nyon mongs rang sar grol ba/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum spangs nas rje 'bangs kyi —537—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonegu ru bsam 'phel nor bu man gong ltar/ nye brgyud ni/ gter ston nas/ drin can ma sangs rgyasakun grol/ gu ru chos kyi rdo rje/ nor won pa/ nor bu don grub/ bzhes garsā chos rgyal/ chos kyi dbang po man gong bzhin no/ /ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bshes gnyen nor bu nas/ kun dga' dpal (382bang rtan/ gter ston lha dbang grags pa/ gu ru tshe brtan/ padma dbang chen/ dme chos skyong / bkra shis lhun grub/ sman lung pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ lha sras 'gro don thugs rje'i byin rlabs las/ grum pa rgyang nasagasol 'debs le'u bdun sogs/ /spyan drangs skyes chen lung bstan ri khrod pa/ /mang lam bzang po grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sprul sku bzang po grags pa ni/ snying tig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byin brlabs pa'i skyes bu stag lo smre ba'i ga sha can chags med 'khor ba spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnas med ri khrod 'dzin pa'i las can des gtsang gram ru lag phyogs nas gter chen 'don rgya gar bal po man dang bod kyi yul skad rigs mi gcig bzhi yi don byed 'gyur de 'dra'i las can lnga brgya dus su 'byung : zhesalung bstan pa'i sprul pa'i sku de lho phyogs shrī'i brag phug tu dwags brgyud pa'i phyag chen gyi nyams len mdzad pa'i skabs gter srung gis bskul te bod sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho rdol ba las skyob pa'i gter grum pa rgyang gi lha khang nas spyan drangs pa rnams kyi nang nas slob dpon chen po nub phyogs srin yul la thegs khar lha sras mu khri btsan pos gsheg skyel la gung thang la thog bar byon te rje rgyal po gung du gshegs slob dpon rṣa po srin po'i kha gnon la 'gyon na bdag dang bod 'bangs rnams ji ltar byed zhus pa'i lan du/ nyen cig bod kyi rgyal po dad pa canaḥ so ges thugasang la gso byed dang / rigasabazang khungs (383na)btsun 'od gsal lha yi brgyud sogs zhal chems dang bcas pa'i sgo nasagasol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i brgyud pa ni le bdun ma dang gcig /gzhan yang gung thang rgyal po la dgongs te gsungs pa'i chos mang yul gung thang du lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung brgyud gcig —540

nor won pa/ nor bu don grub/ bshes garsā chos rgyal/ chos kyi dbang po man gong bzhin no/ /ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bshes gnyen nor bu nas/ kun dga' dpal (382bang rtan/ gter ston lha dbang grags pa/ gu ru tshe brtan/ padma dbang chen/ dme chos skyong / bkra shis lhun grub/ sman lung pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ lha sras 'gro don thugs rje'i byin rlabs las/ grum pa rgyang nasagasol 'debs le'u bdun sogs/ /spyan drangs skyes chen lung bstan ri khrod pa/ /mang lam bzang po grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sprul sku bzang po grags pa ni/ snying tig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byin brlabs pa'i skyes bu stag lo smre ba'i ga sha can chags med 'khor ba spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnas med ri khrod 'dzin pa'i las can des gtsang gram ru lag phyogs nas gter chen 'don rgya gar bal po man dang bod kyi yul skad rigs mi gcig bzhi yi don byed 'gyur de 'dra'i las can lnga brgya dus su 'byung : zhesalung bstan pa'i sprul pa'i sku de lho phyogs shrī'i brag phug tu dwags brgyud pa'i phyag chen gyi nyams len mdzad pa'i skabs gter srung gis bskul te bod sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho rdol ba las skyob pa'i gter grum pa rgyang gi lha khang nas spyan drangs pa rnams kyi nang nas slob dpon chen po nub phyogs srin yul la thegs khar lha sras mu khri btsan pos gsheg skyel la gung thang la thog bar byon te rje rgyal po gung du gshegs slob dpon rṣa po srin po'i kha gnon la 'byon na bdag dang bod 'bangs rnams ji ltar byed zhus pa'i lan du/ nyon cig bod kyi rgyal po dad pa canaḥ so gos thugasang la gso byed dang / rigasabazang khungs (383na)btsun 'od gsal lha yi brgyud sogs zhal chems dang bcas pa'i sgo nasagasol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i brgyud pa ni le bdun ma dang gcig /gzhan yang gung thang rgyal po la dgongs te gsungs pa'i chos mang yul gung thang du lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung brgyud gcig —540
